Inspired by classic vector racing board games, Quantum Racers reimagines the genre for the digital age. The result is a modern, competitive racing experience that rewards tactical thinking, prediction, and mind games.

The game features a bold neon aesthetic, with glowing grids, sharp geometry, and a clean futuristic style that stands out on mobile.

On mobile, unlock the full experience with ranked multiplayer competition, a progression system with upgrades, cross-platform progression from browser to mobile, and skill-based matchmaking.

What sets Quantum Racers apart from other racing games is its focus on strategy over reflexes. It’s closer to poker than a traditional racer, a game of incomplete information where reading your opponent matters more than raw speed.

Designed for players who enjoy competitive mind games, Quantum Racers rewards patience, observation, and bold decision-making.

Short races. No easy wins. Every corner tests your nerve.

Start your first race in the browser, and stay if you can keep winning.

name: Packer Marvel Goo
description:
## Main Functions

### Core Game Functions

- **Classic Sudoku Gameplay**: 9x9 standard Sudoku grid

- **Multiple Difficulty Levels**:

- Easy: Remove 30 numbers

- Medium: Remove 40 numbers

- Hard: Remove 50 numbers

- **Smart Hint System**: Provides helpful hints when cells are not selected or fixed numbers are selected

- **Game Statistics**: Records game time, number of moves, and best score

### Customization Options

- **Symbol Selection**:

- Number Mode: Uses numbers 1-9

- Letter Mode: Uses letters A-I

- **Background Themes**:

- Default gradient background

- Pattern Background 1

- Pattern Background 2

- Game-Specific Background

### User Experience

- **Immersive Status Bar**: Full-screen game experience

- **Smooth Animations**: Button click feedback, title animation, decorative element animation

- **Game History**: Saves the last 5 game attempts

- **Success/Failure Dialog Box**: Beautiful message interface when the game ends

## Gameplay

### Basic Rules
1. **Objective:** Fill a 9x9 grid with numbers (or letters) so that each row, each column, and each 3x3 grid contains 1-9 (or A-I).

2. **Rules:**

- Each row can only contain 1-9 (or A-I) once.

- Each column can only contain 1-9 (or A-I) once.

- Each 3x3 grid can only contain 1-9 (or A-I) once.

- The initial number (black) cannot be modified.

- The user-entered number (blue) can be modified.

### Operation Method
1. **Select Cell:** Click on any cell in the Sudoku grid.

2. **Fill in Number/Letter:** Click the number/letter button at the bottom.

3. **Clear Content:** Click the clear button to delete the content of the selected cell.

4. **Game Over:** All cells are filled or an error occurs.

### Game Flow
1. Start the game and select the difficulty level.

2. Click on an empty cell to select.

3. 4. Use the bottom buttons to fill in the corresponding numbers/letters.

5. Continue filling until the entire grid is complete.

6. A completion dialog box and statistics will be displayed when the game is successful.

## ⚙️ Settings Options

### Difficulty Settings

- **Easy**: Suitable for beginners, removes 30 numbers.

- **Medium**: Standard difficulty, removes 40 numbers.

- **Hard**: Challenge mode, removes 50 numbers.

### Symbol Settings

- **Number Mode**: Traditional numbers 1-9.

- **Letter Mode**: Letters A-I, adding variety to the game.

### Background Settings

- **Default Background**: Classic gradient background.

- **Pattern Background 1**: Simple geometric pattern.

- **Pattern Background 2**: Soft gradient colors.

- **Game Background**: Dedicated game-themed background.

name: Darner Grey
description:
Gameplay Design

Core Gameplay: Players click on two identical blocks. If the line connecting them consists of no more than three zigzag lines (i.e., two turns), the connection is successful and the blocks are eliminated.

After elimination, the empty space can be filled by surrounding blocks, or the blocks themselves may remain stationary.

The player who clears all blocks within the time limit wins.

Game Interface Design
The main interface includes the following elements:

Game Area: Grid layout (e.g., 8x10), with one icon displayed in each square.

Top Bar:

Timer (e.g., 60-second countdown)

Score

Remaining hints (e.g., 3)

Back/Pause Button

Bottom Bar:

Rearrange Button

Hint Button

Sound Controls

Game Logic Design

Tile Generation: The number of tile types varies according to difficulty (6 for beginner, 8 for intermediate, and 10 for advanced).

Ensure all tiles are initially paired to avoid unsolvable problems.

Connection Judgment: Implement a "pathfinding algorithm" to determine if two tiles can be connected (0-2 turns).

Breadth-First Search (BFS) + direction indicators can be used.

Determine if points can be "walked" between in the current grid state.

Elimination Animation: Use a connection effect (line drawing animation), then the two tiles gradually become transparent and disappear.

Each connection can have special sound effects + score jump animation.

⚙️ Difficulty Design
Difficulty | Grid Size | Icon Types | Time Limit | Rearrangement Required
Easy | 6x8 | 6 types | 90 seconds ✅
Medium | 8x10 | 8 types | 75 seconds ✅
Hard | 10x12 | 10 types | 60 seconds ✅

UI/UX Style Suggestions: Fresh colors; icons can use cartoon fruits, animals, or symbols.

Slight shadows can be added to the tile borders to enhance their three-dimensionality.

Connection effects can be set to colored rays or particle-effect trails.

Sound Effects & Special Effects:

Background Music: Light and lively style.

Sound Effects:

Click Sound

Cancel Sound (Simulates crisp sound effects such as "ding," "click," etc.)

Combo sound effect for consecutive successful connections.

High Stakes Trio is a fast-paced, high-energy card game designed for two players. It strips away the complexity of poker and focuses on pure momentum and the luck of the draw. Using a standard 52-card deck, players go head-to-head in a three-round battle where every card counts toward a final point total.

How to Play
The Deal: Both players are dealt three cards face down.

The Showdown: The game consists of three rounds. In each round, both players flip over one card simultaneously.

The Scoring: The player with the higher card value wins the round and adds that card’s value to their total score.

Note: If there is a tie, neither player receives points for that round.

The Victory: After all three cards have been played, the player with the highest cumulative score is declared the winner.

**About Page:** Provides game information and supports a back animation.

- Local data saving, supports progress reset and statistics.

you'll leave the pack behind. Hold too long and you'll spiral out.
Release too early and the other riders will cut inside you.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• UP TO 4 PLAYERS ON ONE DEVICE
  Pass-and-play multiplayer with friends, or race against smart bots

• TOURNAMENT MODE
  Run a full heat schedule with multiple rounds and a final standings

• FULLY OFFLINE
  No internet required. No servers to connect to. Race on a plane, in

• NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO IN-APP PURCHASES.
  Buy once (free), play forever. We don't show you ads, we don't sell

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Speedway Mobile is for anyone who wants a short, pure, honest racing
fix. Commute races. Lunch-break tournaments. Quick matches with a friend

Fans of classic arcade racers, speedway enthusiasts, and anyone who

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

As danger rains down from all sides, you must also rescue wandering chicks that appear across the field—because if even one chick gets hit, the game ends instantly.
Every 45 seconds, the action shifts as a wolf storms into the field and engages one of the foxes in a temporary battle. While distracted, that fox stops attacking, creating brief moments of relief—and new strategic opportunities. description:

- Your choices directly affect the development of the plot. You decide what actions your heroine takes, which ultimately determines the outcome of your story.

Experiment with the wardrobe and choices - become the star of your own plot and make all the characters of the virtual world fall in love with you!

Explore various plots, choose your own paths, and make decisions that can change the course of the story. Each novella is a unique universe with its characters and plots.

Are you ready to dive into one of them?

THE SANDS OF TIME: THE KEY TO ETERNITY

A regular trip to the museum turns into a real-time travel. The heroine gets entangled in a web of intrigue that unfolds several millennia before her birth. Can she return home?

SHADES OF MORALITY

Jazz time, mafia, and prohibition. A time when some are rapidly rising and others are sinking to the very bottom. Who will the young girl become, caught in the dangerous whirlpool of events? Will she be able to choose a side and not make a mistake?

SUIT OF SWORDS

To put an end to the past, the main heroine goes to a mysterious mansion and enters a deadly game. Each guest has their own secrets and reasons to hide their story.

THE SCARLET LINE

A young girl arrives at the Vampires Monastery hoping to earn money, but she gets trapped in a prison. Will she be able to escape and meet the Lord of the castle, and what secret lies in her past?

FRAMED MURDER

A heroine famous for a comic about serial killers never suspected she'd become the target of a real one. Can she survive the deadly game he's devised and remain true to herself?

THE VOICES OF DANSFURTH

In Dansfurth, nightmares bleed into waking life, and every shadow seems to whisper a hidden truth. Can a young newcomer, forced to call this place home, unravel the town's dark secrets and those of her own family or will she be consumed by the encroaching madness?

REVELATION OF WITCHES

Everything in the world has a price, and magic is no exception. To reclaim what she's lost, a witch of the Nightingale lineage must strike an uneven bargain and become entangled in an investigation into missing persons. But how can she conduct a search in a city where nothing is as it seems? And how can she avoid losing herself in the dark woods along the way?

THE PRICE OF REPUTATION

She's a copywriter, not a spy, but Miss Hunt's mission is to find one. However, this dangerous game could push things too far, revealing a truth she's unprepared for.

DRAGON'S HEART

Dragon Kaylar has a dark reputation. All his previous wives vanished without a trace. But the new bride is different from the others. She is ready to fight not only for her life, but for power and influence. Even if she must unravel the secrets of dragons to succeed – this heroine will go all the way, without doubt or regret.

The stories are regularly updated and supplemented according to the feedback of our players!

We invite you to the world of Senses, where you will become the main character! Your decisions determine how your romantic story unfolds. Fall in love, get inspired, and dream with us!

name: Leap Snow
description:
Leap Snow is an arcade-style ski jumping game where the player controls an athlete and strives to achieve the maximum jump distance. In Leap Snow, everything hinges on timing, speed, and precision.

Gameplay in Leap Snow begins with preparations for the descent. The character stands at the top of the mountain, and a single tap initiates the downhill run. As the athlete descends, they build up speed—a factor that directly determines the distance of the jump.

The key moment in Leap Snow is hitting the jump button at the exact right time while on the ramp. If you press it too early or too late, the result will suffer. Precise timing allows you to soar the maximum distance and earn more points.

In Leap Snow, the player has a limited number of attempts. Each attempt offers a chance to improve your score, and once all jumps are completed, the final score is displayed.

Your personal best score in Leap Snow is saved and accessible in a dedicated section, allowing you to track your progress and strive for new records.

Additionally, Leap Snow allows you to customize your character's appearance. Players can choose a nickname and avatar, as well as change their gear and style, adding a touch of individuality to their profile.

The game's settings menu provides options for music control and quick access to your player profile.

Leap Snow combines simple controls, timing-based gameplay, and a competitive element, turning every attempt into a quest to beat your own personal best.

name: Olymp Gate Legends
description:
Enjoy a calm and straightforward casual arcade game set in a beautiful fantasy sky with floating islands and a dramatic sunset background. The gameplay is simple and relaxing: various objects fall from the top of the screen, and you need to tap them before they reach the bottom. Each successful tap gives you points and helps you continue playing.
You start with a limited number of hearts. Missing too many objects costs you one heart each time. When all hearts are lost, the round ends. The goal is to tap as many falling objects as possible and survive for as long as you can to achieve a high score. The objects fall at a steady pace, giving you enough time to react thoughtfully.
The visuals are rich and pleasant with warm orange and purple tones, glowing effects, and a majestic floating castle in the background. The falling objects are clearly visible and have nice animations. The overall atmosphere feels dreamy and peaceful, creating a comfortable environment for relaxed play. Controls are extremely easy - just tap anywhere on the screen where an object appears. No swiping, dragging, or complicated gestures are required. This makes the game perfect for short sessions or when you want to practice your timing and gradually improve your best score.
This casual game is ideal for quiet moments when you need light and focused entertainment. The sound effects are soft and satisfying, with gentle tap feedback and calm background music that keeps the mood positive without being distracting. The experience feels approachable and suitable for players of all ages who enjoy simple tapping-style arcade games.
Return to the floating sky world whenever you want an easy and enjoyable distraction. With its straightforward tap controls, beautiful fantasy visuals, and gentle difficulty, this casual game offers a relaxing way to collect points, manage your hearts carefully, and steadily improve your score. Tap the falling objects accurately, watch your points grow, and enjoy the calm satisfaction of steady gameplay in this pleasant arcade experience.

Connect tiles with limited moves, solve increasingly tricky puzzles, and enjoy relaxing gameplay. With thousands of levels and simple rules, it’s easy to start—but hard to master!

name: Octopus Feast
description: Grow from a tiny octopus into a powerful ocean predator! Explore vibrant underwater worlds, devour fish to get stronger, and evolve new abilities along the way. Unlock upgrades, discover hidden treasures, and dominate the ocean as the ultimate sea creature.

name: Moneyland
description: Build a city, invest in businesses, and grow a money empire! Unlock shops, banks, and restaurants to increase income and expand faster. Ride, collect, and upgrade to become the ultimate city owner in Moneyland!

name: Money Rush
description: Choose the right gates, multiply the coins, and build the money empire in Money Rush! Step into the world of Money Rush, where every decision brings closer to becoming the ultimate cash tycoon. This hyper-casual runner is all about speed, strategy, and maximizing the money. Collect coins, run through profitable gates, and grow the fortune!

name: Merge the Jelly
description: Spawn jellies and match them by color. The more they merge, the more valuable they become. Sell them to earn money, unlock more jellies, and expand the play area. Enjoy endless fun!

name: Lifting Hero
description: Lift weights, grow stronger, and become a giant! Start with small lifts, build your muscles, and unlock bigger challenges as you progress. Upgrade your strength, lift faster, and reach massive objects. Train hard, keep improving, and become the ultimate Lifting Hero!

name: I Want Pizza
description:
Collect & stack doughs and prepare foods for the customers.
Expand the repertoire by preparing different foods like pizza, donut, hotdog.
Be the best chef and deliver as many foods. Upgrade the foods to earn more money!
Avoid obstacles and try not to give them for free!

name: Arrow Fest
description: It is time to control your arrows, pick the best gates, and destroy everyone on your way! Collect lots of coins and upgrade your arrows and income! Try to reach a maximum number of arrows to kill all the enemies and giants! Become the master of arrow control! === HOW TO PLAY === ◉ Simple and intuitive game with easy-to-remember controls ◉ Just swipe to control your arrows ◉ Pass through the best gates to increase your arrows ◉ Destroy your enemies and giants to earn lots of coins

name: Arcade Hole
description: Everything is edible and nobody can stop you! If you are looking for fun io games then look no further, because Hoard Master is a game that will change your hole life! In this game, you are a black hole with no limits! Swallow different items from tiny to massive and push them out to turn them into money. Make money to use it to upgrade your hole, get bigger, and shred what you ate! Consume everything in the city because you can!

name: Aqua Rush!
description: Tap and match characters with the same colors and slide them!

name: High Heels!
description: High Heels, a shoe game is fun, this runway is epic, this shoe race is for baddies! The taller your heels are, the easier it will be to escape from the walls. A different obstacle awaits at each parkour! There are rails on the roof to spread the legs and slide, walls to jump, a stick to balance and a huge podium waiting at the end of the road.

name: Hair Challenge
description:
Step into the dazzling world of Hair Challenge, where beauty meets action in a fast-paced runner adventure. Run across stunning rooftops, collect hair extensions to grow ultra-long hair, and avoid scissors, saws, and sharp obstacles to keep your style intact.

Strut down the catwalk in high heels, pick up vibrant hair dyes, stylish outfits, and trendy accessories. Whether aim for a bold new look or protect the precious strands, every step is a fashion moment.

name: Gun Ganf
description:
Gun Gang 3D is the best survival game; gun shooting, running, fighting all excitement in one game. Dodge wrecking balls, trash containers, sand piles, and all kinds of obstacles, and be sure to cross the finish line with a huge gang!

Start running and shooting 3D obstacles and collect other shooters on the way, grow the crowd and get a massive shooting gang! Move forward and lead the Gun Gang through the obstacle course. Plan the strategy on the run and clash as many as possible!

name: Rapid Reload
description:
Collect magazines for the pistol and improve the shooting on your way.
Also there are unique skills to double the fun and burst fire mode to even triple it.

name: Astro Arena
description: Astro Arena is based on fast-paced combat and is characterized by a combination of battle royale elements and team-based gameplay.

name: Sunrise Village
description: Explore a peaceful village surrounded by nature. Help your grandfather with handling a farm. Meet friendly villagers. Dive into exciting mysteries also your way.

name: Road to Valor : Empires
description: Command your own mythical army!

name: Road to Valor : World War II
description: The biggest war in history, World War II. Be the General and gain the victory!

name: The Battle Cats
description: Weirdly Cute Cats (?) rampage across the world!

name: Time Takers
description:
Time Takers is a fast-paced, third-person team-based survival shooter where time itself is the ultimate resource.
  
Drop into intense battle zones where momentum shifts in an instant. Collect Time Energy, upgrade abilities mid-match, extend survival in critical moments by sharing your lifespan with teammates, or spend everything in a desperate final push.

name: LIFE IS STRANGE: REUNION
description: Play as both Max and Chloe as an all-new story builds towards an epic finale! In three days, a deadly inferno will destroy Caledon University. Max’s Rewind power has bought her time – but she can’t prevent the blaze alone. Can Max & Chloe find a future together

name: Ojol Fight Club and Simulator
description: An open world RPG-Racing where drivers fight for passengers and their life.

name: GoreBox
description: GoreBox is a singleplayer-only chaotic, physics-driven sandbox game where players can embrace their creativity & experiments in the game highlighted with weapons, cars, NPCs, with realistic physics and gore.

name: Farm Tap
description:
Are you ready to test your brain with the ultimate farm game challenge? The old farm is in chaos! The pigs, sheep, and cows are stuck in a messy barn escape. It’s like a classic parking jam 3D, but way cuter and fluffier!
Your mission is simple: Unblock animals and send them safely to their zones. But wait! It’s not that easy. The animals are blocked by fences, barrels, and each other. You need to use your logic to solve this tricky traffic puzzle.

name: Knit Away
description:
Welcome to Knit Away — a cozy, colorful puzzle adventure where sorting threads brings calm and challenge together.
Put your organization skills to the test as you unravel vibrant yarns from beautifully knitted designs. Every move brings satisfying order to chaos in this soothing yet stimulating brain teaser.

name: Cooking Playtime: Tasty Street
description: Cooking Playtime: Tasty street - the most addicting cooking time management games available. You will prepare, offer unique foreign cuisine, and have fun with the fast-paced action in the food fever.

name: Screw Land 3D
description:
Welcome to Screw Land 3D ! Dive into the world of screw pins, nuts and bolts puzzles for endless fun and relaxation! 
Take your puzzle-solving skills to the next level with our exciting 3D mode! Rotate detailed 3D objects, unscrew pins from every angle, and challenge your brain like never before.

name: Tidy Up - Satisfeel ASMR
description: Tidy Up: Satisfeel ASMR game brings you a moment to clean your soul, clear your mess, and help you overcome your stress. It's time to let your mind free and pampered.  Just relax with the simple gameplay with various minigames and organize puzzles.

name: Tribal Wars 2
description: Build your villages and expand your empire. Ally yourself with other players to form mighty tribes. Protect your people against your enemies. And turn the tides of war. Tribal Wars 2, the free online strategy games. You become the ruler of a city in a war torn medieval universe and you have to defend your followers and your village and expand your empire to ensure its survival.

name: Grepolis
description: Conquer the world of Grepolis. Begin by expanding your village in Ancient Greece. Grepolis is a free strategy game in which you build your own empire and strike back against your enemies with the help of allied players and powerful alliances.

name: Tribal Wars
description: Tribal Wars is a medieval strategy game which offers complex strategies and fun with a simple gameplay. Upgrade your village to a mighty fortress and raise your army. Band together with other players to form a powerful tribe and lead your troops into battle. Conquer the villages of your enemies and expand your empire.

name: River City Saga: Journey to the West
publisherName: Arc System Works Asia Co., Ltd.
description:
A roguelike action game where you grow stronger with each run!
Obtain Secret Skills from gods who randomly appear as you progress through the stages to boost your abilities and stats!
With a whopping 80 different Secret Skills available, discover your ultimate build and mow down the swarms of enemies!

name: iRacing
description: iRacing is an online subscription-based racing simulator focused on realistic physics, structured competition, and officially licensed motorsport content. Players compete in multiplayer or single player races across road, oval, dirt oval, and dirt road disciplines using laser-scanned tracks and detailed vehicle models.

name: Fangtopia
description: Create your very own spooky realm in this relaxing builder/puzzle game. Shape the landscape, place eerie landmarks, open portals, welcome friendly monsters, lay rails for the ghost train, complete special objectives and admire the playfully fiendish little worlds that you create!

name: Merge Gardens
description: Merge Gardens is a relaxing puzzle game that combines merge mechanics with match-3 gameplay. Players restore a neglected garden by solving colorful puzzles, merging items to create more powerful objects, and unlocking new areas. Along the way, they uncover a charming story, collect creatures, and bring the garden back to life.

name: Billionaire Chef: Idle Tycoon
description: Take charge of your franchise empire and become the ultimate cooking tycoon! Start with a single food stand and work your way up to the top.

name: Cinema Panic 3: Cooking Game
description: Attend cinema customers waiting in line before watching a movie to enjoy the most delicious popcorn, hot dogs, sodas, hamburgers and more.

name: Cafe Panic: Cooking game
description: Serve delicious drinks and snacks to customers, upgrade your café, and expand your business. Test your time management skills in this fast-paced cooking game!

name: Slugterra All-Stars
description:
Dive back into the thrilling adventures of Slugterra with Slugterra All-Stars!

This action-packed compilation brings together four fan-favorite games: Battle for Slugterra, Secret of the Shadow Mines, Slug Run, and Slug Wars!

Experience the excitement all over again, now fully optimized for your PC.

Get ready to master your slugs, take on epic challenges, and become the ultimate Slugslinger in this must-have collection for any Slugterra fan!

name: Rift Rangers
description:
Take command of the Rift Rangers, powerful sentai tasked with protecting the Earth from evil forces – especially those with lasers and sharp claws pouring through a dimensional instability rift from The Master Brain.

To save the planet, you must enter the rift and use your RiftTech to hold back overwhelming hordes of inter-dimensional monsters for 20 increasingly intense minutes – until your Mega Mecha can finalize its power-up cycle and stomp them all!

name: Beyblade Burst Rivals
description:
BEYBLADE BURST RIVALS is the official fast-paced match-3 puzzle battle game based on the hit boy’s action property, BEYBLADE BURST, which follows the adventures of Valt Aoi and the rest of the gang as they strive to become the world’s greatest Bladers.

Choose your favorite character and follow them on their quest to become a Master Blader as they enter BEYBLADE BURST tournaments, use rare and powerful Beys with the help of your loyal Avatars and participate in epic battles.

name: Monster Jam Extreme Mayhem
description:
Step into the world of Monster Jam™ and get behind the wheel of the most legendary monster trucks ever made! 

Drive fan-favorites like Grave Digger™, Megalodon™, El Toro Loco™, and many more as you race, stunt, and smash your way to victory in the ultimate Monster Jam™ mobile game. Play as Your Favorite Monster Jam Trucks: Pick from an epic lineup of officially licensed Monster Jam™ trucks. Every truck is here to deliver extreme mayhem.

name: Slugterra: Slug it Out 2
description: Slugterra: Slug It Out 2 is a battle puzzle RPG where monster collecting meets fast-paced match-3 combat. Build a team of powerful slugs, combine elements, and outthink enemies in tactical battles with real strategy depth.

name: Texas Holdem Poker: Pokerist
description: Pokerist is an online Texas Hold’em poker game where players can enjoy social casino gameplay with virtual chips. The game does not offer real-money gambling. This game is only available to users of legal age. The game offers no possibility of winning money or anything of value. Success in playing this game does not imply your success in a similar real-money casino game.

name: Tales of ARISE - Beyond the Dawn Edition
publisherName: BANDAI NAMCO ENTERTAINMENT ASIA PTE LTD
description:
300 years of tyranny. A mysterious mask. Lost pain and memories. Wield the Blazing Sword and join a mysterious, untouchable girl to fight your oppressors. Experience a tale of liberation, featuring characters with next-gen graphical expressiveness!

Discover a new fate in this complete version of the award-winning action RPG released in 2021, and the additional content from Beyond The Dawn.

name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
description: This title breathes new life into a fan favourite while remaining carefully faithful to the spirit of the original. It follows the story of charismatic pirate and Assassin Edward Kenway as he adventures through 18th Century Caribbean with parkours in cities, and battles at seas, in search of fortune and glory. Modernized in 2026, the new game includes a cast of new characters and stories.

name: Fantamon: Idle RPG
description: Fantamon: Idle RPG is crafted with a whimsical, Ghibli-inspired hand-drawn art style, designed to provide a "healing" and stress-free experience. Unlike traditional idle games, we focus on a Social Squad-based Idle mechanic, allowing players to form teams and progress together effortlessly.

name: TRIANGLE STRATEGY
description:
Three mighty powers have long waged war on the great continent of Norzelia.

This land bears a long and scarred history that includes the Saltiron War, a war that erupted over control of salt and iron resources. A balance of power has been achieved between the Holy State of Hyzante, which controls the salt, the Grand Dutchy of Aesfrost, a land of iron clad in frost and snow, and the forested Kingdom of Glenbook, which lies nestled between the other two powers.

name: Timeline Up
description: Timeline Up! is a fast-paced, interactive game that centers around a simple yet engaging concept: arranging historical events in the right order. Players are presented with a variety of cards, each featuring significant events, inventions, cultural milestones, and scientific breakthroughs from different periods of history. The challenge is to place these events on a timeline, ensuring that they are in the correct chronological order.

name: Hole People
description: Hole People is a physics-based puzzle game where players use strategic thinking to guide characters through challenging obstacles. Each level requires unique solutions to safely navigate characters to their destination.

name: Knit Out
description: The game features deterministic puzzles that remain consistent with each retry, allowing players to improve through trial and error—particularly helpful in more challenging levels. Combined with the absence of time pressure, this design choice lets players solve puzzles at their own pace, enhancing accessibility and minimizing frustration. As players progress, they permanently unlock additional bobbin slots, eliminating the need to unlock them level by level.

name: Drop Away
description:
Combine the best of block puzzles and color-matching games.
Navigate tricky layouts and test your problem-solving skills.
Simply drag and drop to play.
Colorful graphics that bring each puzzle to life.
Start easy and work your way up to more challenging levels.

name: Crowd Express
description:
Strategically navigate buses and cars to untangle traffic jams and clear stations.
Match passengers to their color-coded buses for the ultimate organizing satisfaction.
Challenge your problem-solving skills with clever puzzles and exciting twists.
Perfectly blends relaxing gameplay with strategic depth for endless fun.
Conquer parking and traffic management puzzles across varied, vibrant levels.
Beat the best times, climb the ranks, and prove you’re the ultimate traffic pro.

name: Golf Rival - Multiplayer Game
description: Fun multiplayer golf game! Prove you’re a golf legend and play with friends!

name: Barbie Merge Mystery
description:
Merge and Match: Combine iconic Barbie-inspired items—like hairbrushes, fashion accessories, and nostalgic Barbie toy set pieces—on your board to complete orders and earn rewards.
Use the resources to upgrade buildings, each bringing new characters and stories to life. Every building upgrade introduces iconic characters. Engage in conversations, dive into their stories, and piece together clues.

name: Gecko Out
description:
Drag and move geckos from their ends to navigate intricate paths.
Match each gecko with its corresponding hole to complete the level.
Beat the clock to win, or face the thrill of a near-miss.
Explore a variety of puzzles, each more challenging than the last.
Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Simple controls make it accessible, while complex strategies keep you engaged.

name: Color Block Jam
description:
Slide the blocks freely, but be mindful of obstacles that can block your path. Plan the moves carefully to clear each puzzle.
Combine your logical skills and strategy to clear levels and unlock new challenges.
The intuitive sliding mechanic ensures a fun and seamless gaming experience.
A vibrant game environment that makes the puzzle-solving experience more enjoyable.

name: BLEACH Brave Souls
description: BLEACH Brave Souls — a free‑to‑play 3D action RPG from KLab Inc. that brings the BLEACH anime to life with fast tap‑and‑swipe combat, cinematic special attacks, and a huge roster of collectible characters; join live events, summon via gacha, and battle players worldwide.

name: Candleman
description: Despite the fact that it can only burn for 10 seconds, a little candle decides to walk into the darkness, on a journey to seek the light.

name: Downhill Smash
description: Downhill Smash is a physics-based single-player game where the player controls a vehicle rolling down a mountain slope, trying to stay ahead of a closing avalanche. Along the way, the player encounters obstacles and stylized cartoon zombie enemies. The player uses a limited fuel supply to navigate and chooses how to upgrade vehicles between runs

name: Overcrowded: Tycoon
description:
Overcrowded: Tycoon is a park‑management game where you design and expand a colorful theme park made of paths, rides, decorations, and service buildings.
You place and upgrade attractions, food stands, rest areas, and facilities so that visiting characters move smoothly through the park and stay satisfied.
Visitors show different emotions (happy, bored, tired, etc.), and you adjust the layout or add mascots and services to keep queues manageable and overall mood positive.

name: Evo Pop
description:
Evo Pop is a physics-based strategy game where you guide groups of small, colorful square creatures called Evos as they move around simple, stylized landscapes. You use different spells to make Evos appear, grow larger, or move so that your group occupies more of the area than the other groups.
Evos can interact with the environment (such as sliding down slopes or multiplying faster on certain surfaces), and each type of Evo has its own movement and growth abilities.

name: Forge of Empires
description: Build your empire and journey through the ages: With Forge of Empires, we bring our award-winning strategy game to you iPad and iPhone. Build your city and develop it from the Stone Age to modern times (and beyond).

name: Rise of Cultures
description: Build epic cities and explore a variety of cultures. Find the best strategy to rule your lands. Progress through the game and dive into the well-known cultures of mankind. Fight strategic battles side by side with Caesar. Discover traditions of the mysterious Egypt together with Cleopatra. Research new technologies with Einstein and use science to advance your city

name: Om Nom: Run
description: Om Nom: Run is an arcade-style endless runner game. Players control Om Nom (and other unlockable characters) as they automatically run through different environments, avoiding obstacles, collecting coins, and completing missions. The game features multiple modes, including a story-like campaign and a free-run.

name: Knock Knock Guess who's There?
description:
Finally the cutest game for babies and toddlers! Its interactive, easy, simple and fun, tailored for that age group!
In the form of 'knock knock who is there' they need to guess what animal hides behind the door by identifying the sound it makes and its form.
Any tap will stimulate a cute animation so your kid will easily interact and never get bored!
Includes adorable loveable animals and the cutest imagery and animation, perfect for ages 1 to 4 years.

name: stoneage-idle-adventure
description: Dinosaurus menjadi peliharaan di StoneAge: Idle Adventure! Rasakan StoneAge yang kembali dengan skala besar!

name: Ice Haven
description: Ice Haven is an ice-themed survival strategy game. Build shelters, manage resources and upgrade facilities to survive the extreme cold and dangers. Explore the icefield for supplies, develop character abilities, cooperate with other survivors to expand territories, and experience the fun of doomsday survival and strategic management.

name: Almora Darkosen RPG
description: Embark on a journey to a vast world in Almora Darkosen RPG, a classic retro-style hack and slash game!

name: Nioh 3
description: In the third game in the dark samurai action RPG series Nioh, you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open field.

name: Spatial Vis
description: Spatial Vis is a training tool for engineering, pre-engineering, and other science and technology students. The app teaches freehand sketching of 2D and 3D views, which is an important skill for technical communication and improving one's ability to visualize shapes in 3D. These skills have been shown to increase GPAs and graduation rates in STEM.

name: Pragmata
description:
An all-new Science Fiction action adventure with its own unique hacking twist!
It is the near future, and protagonists Hugh and his android companion Diana, must work together as they make their way through the cold lunar research station.

name: Pepp Heroes: Relic Quest
description:
RPG Koleksi Hero Generasi Berikutnya: Konten Tanpa Batas dan Grafis 2.5D yang Memukau!
Masuki dunia baru yang belum pernah kamu rasakan sebelumnya.

name: Soul Strike
description: Soul Strike adalah RPG idle yang dibangun di atas dunia unik yang terinspirasi oleh alkimia dan homunculus, menggabungkan keseruan utama dari perkembangan karakter dengan elemen berbasis cerita.

name: Legend UP
description: Embark on an action-packed RPG adventure, and become an epic warrior!

name: TOBOT: Action Quiz Heroes
description:
"Solve Quizzes to Protect Daedo with TOBOT!"

"TOBOT: Action Quiz Heroes" is an action-packed quiz game that combines thrilling battles with various trivia quizzes.

name: Shambles: Sons of Apocalypse
description:
“The world you knew is already collapsed.”
As an explorer in a bunker, explore a new world 500 years in the future and decide its fate. You can lead the world back to doom or bring it to peace. It all depends on your choices.

name: Monopoly: Star Wars™ Heroes vs. Villains
description: Team based digital board game in a stylized sci fi cantina. Players choose hero or villain characters and compete in 2v2 or 3v3 to earn Influence Points on a Monopoly style board with reactive dioramas. No elimination or mature content. Passing GO triggers a light, non graphic Star Wars inspired event.

name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
description: A brand-new action RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT – The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales combines stunning HD-2D visuals and exciting action-adventure gameplay for the first time!

name: Eternium
description:
Eternium is a beautifully crafted Action RPG, reminiscent of the great classics.

Hack and slash your way through hordes of skeletons and demons. Battle, collect loot, and craft items to grow in might. Draw runes to trigger devastating spells and abilities. The power feels incredible!

With over 2.6 million reviews averaging 4.8 stars, Eternium is one of the most highly-rated mobile games ever. Start your adventure today!

name: Block Blast!
description:
Enter the world of Block Blast, where every move tests your brain and strategy. Place colorful blocks on an 8×8 board to complete rows or columns and clear them for points. The game features fresh daily puzzles that keep your mind engaged and an endless high-score mode that challenges you to beat your best results.
Easy to learn but full of strategic depth, Block Blast is perfect for both casual players and puzzle fans.

name: Overgeared Hero
description: This is a strategic action title where players merge and organize pixel-art items within their backpacks to defeat opponents

name: Block Crush!
description:
Block Crush is a grid-based block puzzle game with an interface that simulates a wooden texture. Players drag and drop wooden blocks of different shapes onto an 8×8 board to form complete rows or columns and clear them from the board.
The game has no time limit, no power-ups, and no competitive or random elements. Its mechanics rely entirely on the player’s logical thinking and block-placement strategy.

name: SMASH LEGENDS
description: As a multiplayer PvP game, it offers intense global competition, allowing players to strategically battle alongside legendary heroes.

name: Mahjong Blast
description:
Mahjong Blast is a puzzle game inspired by traditional Mahjong, combined with modern casual gameplay. Players match identical tiles to remove them from the board and clear the entire layout.
The game includes hundreds of handcrafted levels with gradually increasing difficulty, designed to test the player’s observation, memory, and logical thinking skills. Each board features a different tile arrangement, requiring players to solve it in their own way.

name: EggSort
description: An Easter-themed match-3 game with a twist.

name: Sudoku Master!
description:
Sudoku Master is a classic logic puzzle game in which players fill the numbers 1 to 9 into a 9×9 grid so that each row, column, and 3×3 subgrid contains all digits without repetition.
The game offers multiple difficulty levels, ranging from easy to advanced, making it suitable for players of different ages and skill levels. There is no time limit and no pressure, allowing players to stay relaxed while focusing on the puzzle and improving their logical thinking skills.

name: inZOI
description: A simulation game where you create your own character and house to live your desired life.

name: Dinkum
description: “Dinkum” is a survival and life simulation game inspired by the Australian Outback. Players can fish, farm, hunt, mine, and craft to build and expand their own town, gathering resources and shaping a community with sandbox elements and high freedom.

name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
description:
The second game of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake trilogy.

After escaping from the dystopian city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant and vast world – sprint across grassy plains on a chocobo and explore expansive environments.

name: Happy Fish
description:
《Happy Fish》 The most popular and loving fish game! It has been installed over 100 million times worldwide.
【More than 3000 kinds of fishes】
【Easy and Relaxing】
【Beautiful Backgrounds】
【Activities & Suprises Every Day】
【Make Friends While Raising Fish】

name: Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur
description: Step into the greaves of King Arthur in this fantasy action roguelite and wield the Broken Excalibur in a quest to rescue the scattered citizens of Camelot, vanquish the calamitous Void Giant, and escape from the Astral Dimension once and for all.

name: Cube KaBAAM: Cryptic Trail
description: Cube KaBAAM: Cryptic Trail is a paddle arcade game where the player must destroy all cubes by guiding the ball towards them.

name: The Wreck
description: The Wreck is a 3D visual novel, follow failed screenwriter Junon as she attempts to make it through the most pivotal day in her life. Relive the past, alter the present, and embrace the future, or without your help, Junon’s story might end in a wreck.

name: Until Dawn: Rush of Blood
description:
From the warped minds of the team behind PS4™ horror classic Until Dawn, comes Until Dawn: Rush of Blood – a virtual reality experience to strike fear into the hearts of every trigger-happy arcade shooter fan.
Arm yourself then blast your way through a horde of enemies and monsters coming at you from all angles. Duck and dodge everything that’s thrown at you in this fright-filled rollercoaster ride from hell– exclusive to PlayStation®VR.

name: God of War Sons of Sparta
description:
Experience an untold chapter in Kratos’ journey set during the harsh years of Spartan training alongside his brother Deimos. Through endless trials, their minds, bodies and hearts have been molded to become Spartan soldiers for whom duty and honor mean everything.

After a fellow cadet goes missing, Kratos and Deimos vow to find him and embark on an adventure that will put their training and Spartan spirit to the test.

name: UNCHARTED: The Nathan Drake Collection
description:
Experience one of the most revered game series of all time as you follow the perilous journey of Nathan Drake across the globe, from humble beginnings to extraordinary discoveries. Meet an unforgettable cast of characters as Drake puts life and friendship on the line in a race against ruthless enemies to uncover unimaginable treasure. 
This package includes the single-player campaigns only for UNCHARTED: Drake’s Fortune, UNCHARTED 2: Among Thieves, and UNCHARTED 3: Drake’s Deception.

name: UNCHARTED 4: A Thief's End
description: Several years after his last adventure, retired fortune hunter, Nathan Drake, is forced back into the world of thieves. With the stakes much more personal, Drake embarks on a globe-trotting journey in pursuit of a historical conspiracy behind a fabled pirate treasure. His greatest adventure will test his physical limits, his resolve, and ultimately what he’s willing to sacrifice to save the ones he loves.

name: The Last of Us™ Complete
description:
Edition includes:
The Last of Us Part I
The Last of Us Part II Remastered

Go back to the beginning and experience the award-winning games that inspired the TV show, as the definitive editions of these two iconic titles are brought together for the first time in one complete collection.

name: The Last of Us™ Left Behind Stand Alone
description: New light is shed on Ellie’s relationship with Riley, her best friend and sometime-mentor from a military boarding school they grew up in together. After disappearing for weeks, Riley returns with a surprising revelation on her whereabouts. Ellie and Riley sneak out of school for the last time, leading to a series of events that will forever change both of their lives.

name: The Last of Us Remastered
description: 20 years after a pandemic has radically changed known civilization, infected humans run wild and survivors are killing each other for whatever they can get their hands on. Joel, a violent survivor, is hired to smuggle a 14 year-old girl, Ellie, out of an oppressive military quarantine zone, but what starts as a small job soon transforms into a brutal journey across the U.S.

name: Top Eleven Be a Soccer Manager
description: Top Eleven is a free online football manager simulation game where players can create and manage their football team, set tactics and take on real opponents. Users master their management skills by competing against friends and other managers from around the globe. Top Eleven offers great amounts of depth while spending just 5-10 minutes a day.

name: Shadow Fight 2
description: Brawls with ninja fighters

name: God of War: Sons of Sparta
description: God of War: Sons of Sparta is an action side scroller where the player takes the role of a young Kratos, during his training days as a member of the Spartan Agoge. The story follows a young Kratos, who along with his brother Deimos, learn the meaning of Duty as they take up a quest to find a missing Spartan boy named Vasilis.

name: Modern Combat 5
description:
Fast-paced first-person shooter gameplay with guns, tactical combat and class systems.
Includes both single-player campaign missions and competitive multiplayer modes (team deathmatch, battle royale, capture the flag).
Heavy emphasis on military action, weapon progression and PvP competition.
