Command your last stronghold, survive the fallout, and save humanity!

name: Mobel bell ringing simulator
description: Mobel is a change ringing simulator for ringers of church bells and handbells.

name: Hustle Castle・Medieval Kingdom
description: Become the Ultimate Lord of Your Medieval Kingdom! Build and upgrade your mighty castle, manage resources, train powerful heroes, and lead epic battles in this thrilling mix of RPG, strategy, PvP combat, and base building. Join a guild, conquer enemies, explore story-driven quests, customize rooms, gear, and champions, defend your stronghold, expand your empire, and rule a vibrant medieval fantasy world full of adventure, danger, glory, and endless strategic possibilities!

name: Tee and Mo Bath Time
description:
Tee and Mo Bath Time is a fun digital toy for kids aged five and under and their caregivers. Tee and Mo is perfect for co-play - enjoy some you-and-me-time together!
Join Tee and Mo for Bath Time. This playful and entertaining app helps to reinforce your child's bedtime routine. Give Tee a bath, pop Mo's musical mouthwash bubbles, brush Tee's teeth, help Tee go to the toilet and now get Tee dry and ready for bed in the BRAND NEW Towel Time mini game!

name: Tee and Mo Play Time
description: Tee and Mo Play Time sees your favourite monkeys from CBeebies have fun together as they make sandwiches, plant seeds, pick flowers, collect fruit for dinner, visit the jungle supermarket and paint Mr Sloth's house. All Tee and Mo games look at the touching and funny relationship between parent and child, and are voiced by Radio 6 DJ, Lauren Laverne.

name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel
description: Digital Card Game

name: eFootball™
description:
The feverish soccer game with a worldwide total of 950 million downloads is waiting for you!
Play eFootball™ with users around the world!

name: 深夜的燒烤店 MidnightBBQ
description: Create your own menu, mix your own seasonings, and decide on your own decor. Hire employees to handle various tasks within the restaurant, and take a break from your busy schedule to listen to the customers' gossip. This is a casual, simple, and fun idle business game.

name: Unknown Fate
description: Unknown Fate is an enigmatic story-driven action adventure set in a surreal world full of mind-twisting puzzles and bizarre creatures

name: Bounce Defense
description:
The Ultimate Physics RPG Adventure awaits ! Use balls to trigger weapons!
Every bounce is a blast! Step into the most addictive physics-based tower defense strategy game where every ricochet matters. In Bounce Defense, you’ll drop into a world of chaotic fun, clever positioning, and explosive chain reactions. Built by Voodoo, this game delivers the perfect blend of easy-to-learn gameplay and deep tactical challenge that fans love.

name: UFO: Aftermath
description: UFO: Aftermath is a 3D isometric, tactical strategy game with a rich and compelling sci fi story.

name: UFO: Aftershock
description: UFO: Aftershock is a combination of tactical squad combat and global strategy that enhances and expands upon its prequel, UFO: Aftermath.

name: World War I
description: World War I is a real-time strategy based on the modified version of the well-known Blitzkrieg engine.

name: Ball Blast Cannon blitz mania
description: Get ready to experience the ultimate space adventure with Ball Blast! As a space captain, it's your duty to defend the galaxy from the alien invaders. Use your ship's powerful cannon to blast away at the enemies and save the day. With its addictive gameplay and stunning graphics, Ball Blast is the perfect game for anyone who loves arcade shooting games. You'll be hooked from the moment you start playing, and you'll love how easy it is to grow your ship and upgrade your weapons.

name: XIII Century – Gold Edition
description: XIII Century Gold Edition combines the highly successful strategy game XIII Century: Death or Glory with the follow-up sequel, XIII Century: Blood of Europe.XIII Century: Death or Glory is an RTS game which immerses players in the Middle Ages.

name: Twilight City: Love as a Cure
description: In Twilight City: Love as a Cure, you're a young vampire passionately in love with a human. However, the curse of being immortal comes at a high price. Your burning desire for blood can destroy your love. It's up to you to search for a cure in the mysterious city of Skylight.

name: Theatre of War 3: Korea
description: Replay the events of the first hot war of the Cold War era, the Korean War, also known as the Forgotten War. Players will be involved in two campaigns, both set in the 1950’s: the North Korean (June 25 – August 20) and the American (September 15 – October 8).

name: Theatre of War 2: Kurst 1943
description: Theatre of War 2: Kursk 1943, the historically accurate and detailed real-time tactical war game, welcomes military history fans to the battle which gave the Red Army the strategic initiative for the rest of the war.

name: Castle Clashers!
description:
Castle Clashers! 🏰 is a fast, ⚔️ PvP castle-vs-castle battler where every brick breaks and every shot counts.
Draft up to 4 unique units, fortify your keep 🛡️, and outsmart rivals in fully destructible arenas 💥.
Win by eliminating all enemy units 💀 or by reducing their castle to rubble 💣

name: Zombies on a Plane
description: Take on the role of the captain of a troubled jumbo jet carrying infected passengers intent on bringing the plane out of the sky, or pit yourself against hundreds of zombies in the interior of a jumbo jet or even walk along the outside as you fight to regain control as one of the passengers.

name: Airborne Attack
description: Prepare to take command of an advanced air defense system in Airborne Attack, the ultimate mobile game for adrenaline-seeking players! Engage in intense battles as you defend against relentless aerial attacks and experience the thrill of controlling a powerful Close-In Weapon System (CIWS) to protect your base from enemy threats.

name: Fort Guardian
description: Get ready for a unique blend of roguelike action and merge mechanics in Fort Guardian, the ultimate defense game that challenges your strategy and tactics! Can you build the perfect defense and survive the waves of enemies while merging upgrades to strengthen your fort?

name: Block Jam: 3D Color Puzzle
description: The cute, casual, block-puzzle match-3 game with endless levels, full of relaxing puzzle-solving logic challenges - and it's free to play offline!

name: Plinko Space - Drop Balls Win
description: A casual ball-drop game where players release balls onto the board in a space-themed environment.

name: Fran Bow
description: Fran Bow is a 2015 graphic adventure game with psychological horror elements developed and produced by Killmonday Games, a Swedish indie game studio.

name: Little Misfortune
description: Little Misfortune is an interactive story, focused on exploration and characters, both sweet and dark, where your choices have consequences.

name: Combine Me!
description:
Let's COMBINE!
Welcome to the world of cute Blocks.
Come play this unique block puzzle!

Includes 2 unique action driven and thought driven block puzzles.
More than 700 puzzles available!
Enjoy the puzzle of your choice anytime, anywhere!

name: Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis
description: "PSO2 New Genesis" is an online action RPG where you can develop and play your own character. It's been around for over 10 years since its predecessor, "PSO2," and offers basic content like combat, story, cooperative play, and communication between players, all for free (with in-game purchases). One of the game's unique characteristics is the ability to freely customize your character with a great variety of costumes and accessories.

name: Samkok Fantasy
description: All Heroes can be yoURs - Kekuatan Tanpa Batas, Kemenangan Mutlak Selamat datang ke Samkok Fantasy, Turn Based - RPG bergaya anime dengan tema era Tiga Kerajaan. Semua Hero bisa menjadi UR! Ciptakan jalan menuju kemenangan dengan tiap formasi yang kamu buat Rancang formasi terbaik sesuai gayamu dan ciptakan strategi unik untuk mendominasi setiap pertempuran! Dengan kebebasan tanpa batas, kemenangan ada di tanganmu! Nikmati gameplay yang seru dan mudah!

name: Lineage2M
description: Lineage2M(L2M) – The Masterpiece Open-World MMORPG by NCSOFT. Experience 4K visuals, a seamless world, and massive scale battles.

name: Beads Out
description: Carefully collect the balls from the conveyor into the boxes, sort all the balls by color into the boxes!

name: Crazy Kick!
description:
Get to the goal!

Overtake your opponents, move swiftly and shoot goals! Dribble, pass and kick. Real football experience complete with easy controls and enjoyable movements.

name: Card Factory! Relaxing Puzzle
description:
Relax, sort, and keep the factory flowing!

Welcome to Card Factory, the ultimate logic puzzle where your goal is to organize the chaos. Send cards to the conveyor, match the colors, and fill the shipping boxes. But be careful—if you miss a match, the cards pile up in the Dock. If the Dock gets full, the factory jams!

name: Neon Wings
description: Dive into a dazzling neon-soaked roguelike where every tap unleashes vibrant explosions! Face an endless hail of falling stones, customize your arsenal of skills, and conquer each level’s crescendo of challenge.

name: This is Blast!
description: Ready to blast your way through puzzles? Welcome to This is Blast, the exciting blast game that combines colorful puzzles, explosive chain reactions, and addictive ball blast mechanics. If you’re searching for a fun, free, and challenging puzzle blast game, you’ve found it.

name: Cut the Rope
description: Innovative physics-based game with 425 levels to explore. Players cut ropes to deliver candy to a small green creature named Om Nom. Each level requires timing and strategy, as you must navigate obstacles and other mechanics while collecting stars.

name: Pixel Gun 3D
description: The legendary mobile multiplayer FPS Pixel Gun 3 with an enhanced world of colorful, blocky action. Featuring dozens of game modes and maps, 1500+ guns plus cross-platform multiplayer and progression.

name: Pixel Gun 3D: PC Edition
description: The legendary mobile multiplayer FPS Pixel Gun 3 with an enhanced world of colorful, blocky action. Featuring dozens of game modes and maps, 1500+ guns plus cross-platform multiplayer and progression.

name: Pixel Gun 3D - FPS Shooter
description: The legendary mobile multiplayer FPS Pixel Gun 3 with an enhanced world of colorful, blocky action. Featuring dozens of game modes and maps, 1500+ guns plus cross-platform multiplayer and progression.

name: Puzzle Solitaire
description: A logic-based jigsaw puzzle game built around card placement rules, featuring handcrafted levels, daily challenges, and single player game.

name: Chicktionary
description:
Master your skills or learn English in a fun way!

Try two fresh ways to enjoy this award-winning word game: JOURNEY across the farm in a spelling adventure, or race the clock in QUICK PLAY. If you’re feeling nostalgic, give CLASSIC mode a try!

name: Death Squared
description:
Death Squared is a puzzle game for 1 or 2 people about coordination, cooperation, and robot explosions.

FEATURES:
- 80+ puzzling levels that unfold via a fully voiced story
- Additional vault levels that are almost too hard for human comprehension
- Voice acting by Ricepirate (look him up he’s funny)
- Original music score by Brad Gentle
- Customisable hats! Because everyone loves hats
- Robot Explosions!
- Optimized to work with Bluetooth controllers

name: OTTTD: Over The Top Tower Defence
description:
HEROCORP™ WANTS YOU. Command heroes, build towers, discover strange and exotic worlds and blow them all to bits.

* An intense tactical blend of Tower Defense and RTS gameplay
* Build and upgrade towers for attack and defense
* Command a squad of heroes
* Go head to head against epic bosses
* Level up heroes, and unlock devastating weapons

name: Thumb Drift
description:
WHY PLAY THUMB DRIFT?
- Over 100 fully unlicensed cars to unlock + more to come
- Simple one thumb controls
- Addictive drifting gameplay
- Original soundtrack with 6 pumping tunes
- 6 different tracks to race on each with a unique feel
- Challenge your friends for the top score
- Cutting edge, flat shaded, low poly graphics
- Groundbreaking Carticle™ Technology

name: SPiNG
description:
Experience the zen and skillful world of SPiNG.
With only one touch, flow through hundreds of hand-crafted levels.
Unlock new themes that change the look and feel of your experience.
Earn new characters and perfect levels to unlock new challenging modes.

name: No Way Home
description: No Way Home is a twin-stick shooter adventure set in a hostile far flung part of the universe filled with danger at every turn. Outgun enemies in tense skirmishes, take on dangerous mercenary missions, loot bigger and better weapons, and explore a huge starmap in search of answers and a way home.

name: Infantry Attack: War 3D FPS
description: Soldier! Are you bored by playing Battle Royale games? World War 3 is coming, and duty calls you! Enemies are invading our country, and we need YOU to defend it, so take your weapons and be ready for the battle!

name: Combat Cruiser
description:
Thrilled to introduce our newest yet thrilling action game to you!
Control your cruiser and equip plus upgrade the weapons as you go, there are many enemies and new weapons to discover!

name: Battle Bag: War Zone
description:
Pack your squad! Watch the war, win the bag!

In Bag of War, it’s all about how you pack — not how you shoot.

Place your soldiers and weapons inside your battle bag. Line them up, connect them right, and create your unstoppable army. Every weapon linked to a soldier brings them to life — rifles, shotguns, SMGs, you name it!

name: Solitairescapes!
description:
Solitairescapes is here! Relax and unwind with a game of Solitaire surrounded by stunning views. It’s the classic card game you love, now set in the most beautiful scenes!

We’ve removed all unnecessary features to give you a clean and intuitive experience. It’s no-fuss Solitaire, with a beautiful design that lets you simply play!

name: Sudoku
description:
Play the classic paper and pencil number puzzle game right on your phone or tablet! Enjoy the timeless classic whether you are a beginner or an expert with our simple & elegant design.

Challenge your problem-solving skills with an expert-level game or take a break with a quick game on easy mode. Whether you’re a hyper-competitive puzzle-solver or looking for a way to relax, a beginner or a master puzzler, Tripledot’s Sudoku for mobile is the best way to pass the time.

name: Solitaire Spider
description:
The Spider Solitaire is a classic solitaire card game. Also known as Spiderette or Spiderwort.

Our classic card game, Spider Solitaire, is FREE to play. We consistently update the game with fun & relaxing new features to keep this classic game fresh.

Train your brain by completing fun Daily Challenges & Goals, where you earn trophies. The more puzzles you solve, the more trophies

name: PUBG MOBILE
description: PUBG Mobile is a free-to-play battle royale video game co-developed by LightSpeed & Quantum Studio and PUBG Studios

name: Dragon Ace Games
description:
Dragon Ace Games is a free-to-play social card/casino-style mobile game that provides virtual card and slot machine simulations for entertainment purposes only.

The game includes:
1. Texas Hold’em Poker (virtual simulation)
2. Blackjack (virtual simulation)
3. Slot machine mini-games
4. Baccarat (virtual simulation)

All gameplay uses virtual chips only.
There is no real-money gambling, no cash wagering, and no real-world prize redemption.

name: Dragon Ace Games
description:
Dragon Ace Games is a free-to-play social card/casino-style mobile game that provides virtual card and slot machine simulations for entertainment purposes only.

The game includes:
1. Texas Hold’em Poker (virtual simulation)
2. Blackjack (virtual simulation)
3. Slot machine mini-games
4. Baccarat (virtual simulation)

All gameplay uses virtual chips only.
There is no real-money gambling, no cash wagering, and no real-world prize redemption.

name: Days Gone Remastered
description:
Days Gone is an open-world action-adventure game set in a harsh wilderness two years after a devastating global pandemic.
Step into the dirt flecked shoes of former outlaw biker Deacon St. John, a bounty hunter trying to find a reason to live in a land surrounded by death. Scavenge through abandoned settlements for equipment to craft valuable items and weapons, or take your chances with other survivors trying to eke out a living through fair trade… or more violent means.

name: Word Blast
description: Clear goals connecting the words on a board. Words puzzle.

name: Sizzle Sort
description: Food sorting puzzle. Food on a grill.

name: Dot Paint
description: Puzzle game. Connect dots to open images.

name: FIFA World Cup 2026™ AXL™
description:
The app allows the users to interact with the cards they have collected offline and play to the official trump card game FIFA World Cup 2026™ AXL™ from their mobile devices and on the web application.
Users can manage their line up and challenge other connected users or train their strategies challenging the AI.

name: 7,62 Hard Life
description: 7,62 Hard Life is a fan made enhanced version of the original tactical sim 7,62 High Calibre.

name: DoubleDown FortKnox Slot Game
description: DoubleDown FortKnox Slot Game is a simulated casino slots game featuring a variety of themed slot machines. Players can enjoy the thrill of spinning reels, winning virtual coins, and unlocking new content within a purely virtual environment.

name: 7,62 High Calibre
description: 7.62 High Calibre is a tactical action game, sequel to Brigade E5. A professional mercenary is in pursuit of a certain Russian "businessman", who stole a large amount of money from his "colleagues". Now he is hiding in a small country of Latin America to avoid an inevitable punishment.

name: Theatre of War 2: Africa 1943
description: Theatre of War 2: Africa 1943 covers the events of 1943 in Tunisia, North Africa. Recovering from their losses after the crushing defeat and subsequent retreat after the Second Battle of El-Alamein, the German Afrika Korps - reinforced and now supported by the Italian Army - prepare once more to put steel against steel with the Allies.

name: Theatre of War
description: Command a special task force composed of different kinds of units, including tanks, APCs, field guns, mortars, various infantry regiments and will also have an opportunity to call for artillery and air support.

name: Renoir
description: Renoir is a story-driven puzzle platformer that draws inspiration from classic 1940s film noir. Detective James Renoir has but a single shot to crack one hell of a case: his own murder!

name: Planet Alcatraz 2
description: The sequel to Planet Alcatraz tells the story of sergeant Hartman, the leader of the Ghoul strike unit, that remained MIA in the original game.

name: Planet Alcatraz
description: Planet Alcatraz is a 3D role playing game with isometric projection. The player travels through the game world and fights against enemies in the real-time mode.Several genres are mixed in this game but despite that fact it isn't stuck between them and appears to be a classical RPG that is based on a specially developed system.

name: Tanki Online
description: Dive into the exhilarating world of Tanki Online, where tanks clash in intense PvP battles! This legendary tank game combines the thrill of shooter mechanics with strategic gameplay. With an arsenal of customizable machines and a variety of combat modes, prepare to unleash your full force in an immersive war of tanks online!

name: World Class Casino
description: Super premium free casino slots, multiplayer blackjack, baccarat, video poker, keno, and poker rooms by the makers of Spanish 21, World Series of Poker Deluxe, World Class Poker with T.J. Cloutier, and PC & Mac casino slots from IGT, WMS, and Bally! Featuring exclusive casino games Spanish 21®, Down Under Blackjack®, and Match the Dealer®.

name: Pck One
description: Pick One is a luck based memory game, with a casual style and several challenges that go beyond random choices. Choose between colors, cards, drinks, directions and many more, repeat sequences and identify the order of the steps in more than 30 challenges.

name: The Baby in Yellow
description:
The Baby In Yellow is a Lovecraftian inspired comedy horror game where you must look after a suspicious baby and survive his attempts to take control.
The Player takes on the role of a Baby sitter looking after this non-human Baby, performing various actions such as feeding, reading a story and taking to bed.

The Game escalates into horror and madness, although there are no visceral acts of violence against the baby or the player. No real weapons, blood or gore.

name: Double Money
description:
Get your net worth to the moon!
First, play rock-paper-scissors to decide to goes first, then grow your money stack by picking up the best cards, make sure you have more money than your opponent.
Simply tap a card to use it!
Don't forget about red cards, you can reduce your opponent stack by using them, but so can do your opponent so be careful.

name: Rig n Roll
description: Players will step into the shoes of a young man in the year 2014 as he arrives in California to pursue his dreams of road domination and capture the Californian cargo transportation market. There are miles of highways to conquer and cities and towns to reach as he becomes the greatest trucker on the highways.

name: Shiny
description: Left to fend for himself after mankind abandoned the doomed planet Aurora, robot Kramer 227 must find a way through 20 action-packed levels and rescue his robotic friends before Aurora crashes into its sun.

name: Reign: Conflict of Nations
description: Reign: Conflict of Nations allows players to have a well thought-out and historically accurate system of building and assigning labor forces in cities, a large selection of scenario-based and random missions, an expansive and realistic technology tree, more than 150 types of military units and elaborated graphics and animations which brin

name: Real Warfare 2: Northern Crusades
description: Real Warfare 2: Northern Crusades is the next installment in this series of realistic real-time strategy games covering various periods in the development of the present day civilization – from the Middle Ages to today.

name: Real Warfare 1242
description: Real Warfare: 1242, is a realistic real-time strategy game based on authentic historic events.

name: Re-Legion
description: Become The Prophet in a world of the future without the future! Lead your Cult in this cyberpunk RTS in the fight against evil corporations and heretics. Choose your creed, convert citizens, create an army and take over the city!

name: The Tomorrow War
description: The Tomorrow War is a space sim based on the trilogy of novels written by a famous Russian author, Alexander Zorich. These books are dedicated to the intergalactic war of two mighty empires. Along with the graduates of the military-space academy players will witness different stages of the conflict.

name: Dawn of Magic 2
description: The well-known Action-RPG Dawn of Magic will now be continued as the evil forces won't leave the world without a desperate struggle after the death of the monstrous immortal Modo. Peace is ruined, the fragile balance of the forces that remained for 10 years has fallen into pieces.

name: Stalingrad
description: Stalingrad is a real-time strategy title that places gamers in the middle of the most dramatic periods of World War II, covering major events from June 1942 till January 1943.

name: Star Wolves 3: Civil War
description: Large-scale battles have become a vestige of the past, depleting resources of conflicting parties. Settled space, where welfare and order had reigned, has become a cemetery for dead ships which is flooded with pirates and adventurists.

name: Star Wolves 2
description: Six years have passed after the events of 2226 A.D. The balance in the galaxy has been restored as transgalactic corporations have been deported to the outskirts of the galaxy and deprived of their power. The Empire, just as before, continues to fight against the Aliens. As a rule armadas of battleships aren't used in such conflicts.

name: Star Wolves
description: Star wolves is a 3D space RPG with deep strategy and tactical elements. The game thrusts players into a world of freelance space hunters in the XXI-XXII century A.D. during a time of political crisis for the all-powerful Empire and the three mega-corporations that control all the known worlds.

name: Pilot Brothers 3: Back Side of the Earth
description: Berdichev, Spring 1958. Sensible Brother Chief and his not-so-bright assistant, Brother Colleague saw a report in papers that in Tasmania number of rare animals was greatly reduced. Help Chief and Colleague to save poor elephants!

name: Pilot Brothers 2
description:
Join the famed duo in their search for the serial maniac!
The Pilot Brothers’ cat Arsenic has been kidnapped by Experimental Chef Sumo! Now the famed duo must track down Arsenic before he’s served with French fries. Per usual, this madcap detective adventure won’t be without its twists and turns, as the brothers must start by constructing a composite of the catnapper’s face with the help of a witness.

name: Pilot Brothers
description: The case of the stolen elephant! Elephant... Rare... Striped. ...has been kept for many years by an animal trader named Karbophos. Being unable to overcome abuse, it escaped and found a home at the zoo in our city. This is definitely Karbophos's work. To the zoo!

name: Perimeter: Emperor's Testament
description: The game expands the story of the original Perimeter in a vast singleplayer campaign.

name: Perimeter
description: Perimeter is an innovative Real-Time-Strategy game that pits players against each other or AI opponents in a life and death struggle to seize territory and establish crucial protective “perimeters.” Players will be introduced to the game’s unique terraforming feature, allowing them to move, build, construct and destroy the map...

name: Misty Continent: Cursed Island
description:
Explore the Cursed Island, build up your Stronghold! Gear yourself up for dangerous quests in the mist. 
Craft unique Artifacts! Clear all your obstacles by having more treasures and powerful abilities that will aid your treasure hunts
Make Friends Around the World! Gather your army and fight alongside your buddies!

name: Hitman: Absolution
description:
Branded a traitor and hunted by the Agency he once served, Agent 47 returns in lethal form.

Stalk your targets through elaborate environments designed to reward both quick thinking and patient planning. Strike silently from the shadows, or let your silverballers do the talking — whatever your approach, each of Absolution’s 20 missions is a contract killer’s happy hunting ground that invites exploration, experimentation and improvisation.

name: Stormshot: Isle of Adventure
description: The game is set on the treacherous Isle of Adventure. Players take on the role of an intrepid adventurer and must rely on their wits to navigate through the challenges that lie ahead.

name: Boom Blast: Doomsday
description:
Tear down enemy constructions as you beat 500 levels of mind-twisting demolishing puzzles. Experience all the fun while you are mastering the skill of cannon-firing!
Beneath your feet lies the lost treasure island filled with danger and mysteries. To survive this unforgiving world, you must wield your greatest weapons: your unmatched wit, flawless aiming and absolute focus to fend off whatever evil may come!

name: DoubleDown Classic Slots
description: DoubleDown Classic Slots is a simulated casino slots game featuring a variety of themed slot machines. Players can enjoy the thrill of spinning reels, winning virtual coins, and unlocking new content within a purely virtual environment.

name: Aha World: Doll Dress-Up Game
description: Aha World is a creative simulation game where players can design personalized characters, build dream homes, and explore diverse worlds.

name: Mahkota dan Rindu
description:
A Journey Through Time — Road to Revival
A modern girl travels through dreams, witnessing the wisdom and courage of women across eras.

Ancient Intrigue
Navigate tense court politics and rise step by step toward the throne.

Endless Fashion
Stunning outfits and makeup allow limitless style transformations.

Romantic Companions
Four loyal men join your adventure, shaping a heart-stirring love story.

name: LEGO BATMAN : LEGACY OF THE DARK KNIGHT
description: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight lets the player take on a journey that begins the origins of Batman as a young Bruce Wayne who trains with the League of Shadows to become the hero of Gotham City. You’ll encounter iconic villains such as The Joker, Penguin, Mr. Freeze, Poison Ivy and more. Story missions taken from memorable moments from the movies which interwove with each other as you solve a unique mystery in finding out who the main villain is.

name: Resident Evil Requiem
description: Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living. Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.

name: The Cozy Florist
description: Looking for a heartwarming game to relax without boredom? Eager to meet like-minded friends but afraid of social awkwardness? This game filled with flowers and surprises solves all your worries!

name: All Who Wander
description: All Who Wander is a traditional roguelike with 30 levels and 10 character classes, inspired by games such as Pixel Dungeon. Fight or evade your enemies, discover powerful items, gain companions, and master over 100 abilities.

name: Arknights
description: Take on the role of a key member of Rhodes Island, a pharmaceutical company that fights both a deadly infection and the unrest it leaves in its wake. Together with your leader Amiya, you’ll recruit Operators, train them, then assign them to various operations to protect the innocent and resist those who would thrust the world into turmoil.

name: A Dance of Fire and Ice
description: A Dance of Fire and Ice is a rhythm game where you tap the screen to make 2 circles travel along a twisting path to the beat of music.

name: Khan Academy Kids
description: Khan Academy Kids is a free educational app for children ages 2–8, offering interactive lessons in reading, writing, math, and social-emotional development. Featuring colorful characters, engaging games, and adaptive learning, the app adjusts to each child's level as they progress. It's entirely free with no ads or subscriptions, making it accessible for families and educators alike. Content aligns with early learning standards.

name: The Book of Desires
description: Explore an intriguing world in The Book of Desires, a thrilling Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game! Ashley had a horrible dream where she traveled to a strange world. When she awoke she realized it was just a nightmare, but her reality turns out to be just as scary...

name: Space Rangers: Quest
description: SPACE RANGERS: QUEST is a new text adventure in the world of Space Rangers with a touch of nostalgia. Save the Coalition from the new threat!

name: The Biggleboss Incident
description: A pointy-clicky comedy corporate thriller. Solve puzzles, get to know your colleagues, and unravel a sinister global conspiracy. All in a day's work.

name: Konung 2
description: The world of Konung is a unique and spacious fantasy land, that combines parts of known history with classical myths and the legends of the Chronicles, including immortal heroes, magical artefacts and ancient sorcery.

name: Tacticool
description: Tacticool is an action-packed 5v5 top-down shooter, where teamwork and tactics are your keys to victory. Variety of heroes and weapons allow you to play different styles. Immersive locations and moving environments can be your friend or foe. In this game you can break the rules and chase your enemies in cars and have a lot of fun.

name: Brigade E5: New Jagged Union
description: Brigade E5: New Jagged Union is a tactical game that places gamers in the small tropical nation of Palinero on the verge of a civil war. The mission: hire a band of mercenaries and take control of the deteriorating situation before the country finds itself in complete ruin.

name: Mystery of Unicorn Castle: The Beastmaster
description: Make your way past the ingenious traps of the Castle and overcome the beasts to restore the Unicorn for a victory over the forces of evil! Can you solve the Mystery of Unicorn Castle - The Beastmaster?

name: Mystery Castle: The Mirror's Secret
description: Groth, the Soul Reaver, has kidnapped your daughter Jessica! Explore the dangerous world of the ancient castle and help release the captive souls whom you meet along the way. Can you solve the ingenious traps of the mysterious castle? Defeat Grot's magic and save Jessica!

name: Death Track: Resurrection
description: Do you have what it takes to Survive? Death Track: Resurrection is a racing/action title that takes players into a post-apocalyptic, not-too-distant future where traditional sports have been replaced by far more violent entertainment.

name: Parkan 2
description: Parkan II is an original concept game that will allow you to feel as a pilot of a spacecraft lost somewhere in the universe. Become a pirate or mercenary, get money to buy the most powerful cruiser and show them all who is to be the new master of the galaxy. Unforgettable adventures in the Parkan II universe await you!

name: BorderZone
description: BorderZone is a role-playing action with a complex non-linear storyline in which the player can choose a profession to his liking (mage, thief or soldier), learn the needed skills and spells, create a team of up to 5 dare-devils and leave for a trip full of unexpected discoveries in the world of Terra filled with various creatures.

name: Ascension to the Throne
description: Ascension to the Throne is a turn-based strategy game with RPG elements. In a vast fantasy world the hero will have to pass many tests on his way to victory. Enemies seek to stop players from regaining power and taking revenge. Gain new friends to aid you in reclaiming the throne.

name: In Fear I Trust
description: In Fear I Trust is a critically acclaimed first-person horror adventure. Explore eerie locations, solve puzzles and unravel the dark truth behind a secret soviet experiment in this story-driven psychological thriller.

name: Terrain of Magical Expertise
description: Terrain of Magical Expertise is a game about a game! Take on the role of a White-Hat Hacker in this non-linear, story-driven, RPG adventure, featuring an original turn-based combat system, hundreds of unique enemies, and a full cast of voice actors. Do all it takes to win the Campaign of Champions!

name: RC Cars
description: R.C. Cars is an exciting arcade racing game featuring the world of highly realistic toy radio controlled cars. Jump, accelerate, perform acrobatic feats in the air, and bounce on big hummocks, pits and bumps while contending with opponents for victory.

name: Fall of Light: Darkest Edition
description: Fall of Light is a story-driven dungeon crawler set within a world consumed by Darkness, where an old warrior takes his daughter to see the last remnants of sunlight. Only together will they be strong enough to defeat the enemies born from the Shadow.

name: IL-2 Sturmovik: Cliffs of Dover Blitz Edition
description: Scramble to intercept in your RAF Spitfire or Hurricane. Or join huge formations of German or Italian Fighters and Bombers as they roar across the Channel towards London. Decide the fate of Britain!

name: IL-2 Sturmovik: 1946
description: Il-2 1946 includes all of the original IL-2 series content: IL-2 Sturmovik™: Forgotten Battles, Ace Expansion Pack, Pacific Fighters™ and alternate histry campaigns of year 1946. What was years ago began as a one-aircraft study sim is now an astonishing anthology, with a whopping 229 flyable aircraft and over 300 aircraft total!

name: Horror Story: Hallowseed
description: Horror Story: Hallowseed is a story-driven psychological horror game. An obscure event causes two of your friends to disappear while you were camping in the woods. Left alone and stranded in an unknown place, you need to seek the answers about what happened, face the horror and find your friends.

name: Haimrik
description: Make words come to life in this action adventure unlike any other! Haimrik blends gameplay with the narrative of its story set in medieval times. Combined with crisp humor and rare visual style, Haimrik’s journey is sure to entertain. Word’s the word!

name: Gift of Parthax
description: Gift of Parthax is a 2D top-down action-arena game of gladiatorial wizardry! Customize your arsenal of countless spells, duel the masters of the arena with their mythological beasts, and rescue your friend Veleus from the powerful mage, Parthax!

name: Fantasy Wars
description: Fantasy Wars is a turn-based strategy game set in a fantasy world. Combining both classic strategy gameplay and sophisticated 3D graphics players can experience epic battles like never before. Taking place in a fantasy world of Human kingdoms, Orc clans, Dwarfs' citadels and Elven forests the player is thrust into a world of war and...

name: NecroVision: Lost Company
description: NecroVisioN: Lost Company is the prequel to original horror FPS shooter, taking place before the NecroVisioN story begins. It contains a bunch of unique levels, characters, weapons and gameplay elements as well as new main hero that presents the original game story from opposite perspective.

name: NecroVision
description: War is Hell. NecroVision is a first-person shooter that takes gamers across the frantic battlegrounds of World War I and into a dark underworld of vampires, demons and dark magic.

name: Omnibion War
description: Transform your high-tech space jet into a flying mech at the touch of a button as you blast your way through the galaxy in this frantic 3D shoot ‘em up. Take down thousands of Hellhounds one by one and prevent them from acquiring Omnibion, a dangerous ancient weapon.

name: Off-Road Drive
description: Off-Road Drive, the off-road racing simulation for PC, is the first game ever to deliver a true-to-life, off-road, extreme racing experience. Players will take part in The Russian trophy, Off-Road Trial, Thai Trophy and many other events through the worst driving conditions with a variety of natural obstacles like swamps, rocks, snow and...

name: Restaurant Empire:Build & Cook
description: Turn a small eatery into a world-class restaurant empire! Customize your restaurant, create the perfect menu, and serve delicious meals to happy customers. Upgrade your kitchen, unlock new recipes, and compete with top chefs to become the ultimate restaurateur.

name: Freight Tycoon Inc.
description: Freight Tycoon is an economic simulation game which challenges players’ management skills. It puts one into the shoes of an owner of a cargo transportation company. One has to evaluate the profitability of contracts, contact customers, and appoint drivers to deliver goods.

name: Kapital: Sparks of Revolution
description: Sandbox economic simulation game about class struggle. European country is in a deep crisis. You are the mayor of the capital. Social unrest is inevitable. What price will you pay to save your people from anarchy?

name: Faces of War
description: Faces of War puts you in the heart of World War II – not as a distant commander, but as the leader on the ground. Combining the tactical depth of real-time strategy with the immediacy of direct control, it lets you issue precise orders or jump straight into battle as one of your soldiers.

name: Eternity: The Last Unicorn
description: Classic RPG, with lore based on Norse mythology. Travel through mesmerizing locations, meet fantasy characters and fight to protect Elven immortality.

name: Cuban Missile Crisis: Ice Crusade
description: Ice Crusade is a stand-alone expansion for post-apocalyptic real time strategy Cuban Missile Crisis. Ice Crusade continues the original story and adds new campaigns, battlegrounds and units.

name: Elven Legacy
description: This sequel to Fantasy Wars continues its story after banishing the archdemon. The shadows of destruction begin to loom on the horizon once a human mage uncovers a dark and powerful secret dating back to the remote past of the Elven race.

name: Project Entropy
description:
Project Entropy is a Sci-Fi and role-playing game with space battles. Immerse yourself in this MMO experience where you'll command alien civilizations, conquer uncharted planets, and build Hero fleets.
Challenge other players in intense PvP battles or team up with friends to take on challenging PvE encounters. Test your skills, strategy, and teamwork to emerge victorious in battle.

name: Hero Wars: Alliance
description: Hero Wars: Alliance is a strategy RPG where legendary heroes rise to save Dominion. The Archdemon has won, the Guardians have fallen — only you can turn the tide. Collect and upgrade 80+ heroes from six factions, build powerful team synergies, and lead them into battle. Compete in PvP Arena and draft battles, conquer PvE challenges like the Tower, explore limited-time adventures, and command mighty titans in epic guild wars. Collect. Upgrade. Conquer.

name: State of Survival: Zombie War
description: Survive with your strategy!

name: Idle University
description: You’ve just been accepted to one of the nation’s most prestigious universities! As a new student at Idle University, you’re out to make a name for yourself, but you won't be able to do it alone! Recruit students to join you and lead your study group to academic greatness!

name: World League Live!
description:
World League Live! – Ultimate Multiplayer Soccer Game
Experience exhilarating multiplayer soccer action on mobile! Join World League Live!, the fastest-paced multiplayer soccer game where you can challenge friends and thousands of players worldwide. Strike, score epic goals, and dominate the field with incredible power-ups. Ready to show who’s the G.O.A.T. in football? 🏆

name: Iron Force
description: Join global tank warfare!

name: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
description:
From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT.

In the future, a mysterious event known as the Death Stranding has opened a doorway between the living and the dead, leading to grotesque creatures from the afterlife roaming the fallen world marred by a desolate society.

As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America.

name: Home Design: Fix ASMR
description: Dive into the calming world of Home Hammer Fix ASMR, where you step into the shoes of a compassionate helper. Join a mother and her baby on a heartwarming journey to rebuild their cherished home. With each gentle tap and soothing sound, you'll embark on a therapeutic adventure, fixing, repairing, and renovating alongside them. From patching up walls to assembling furniture, every task brings you closer to transforming their space into a cozy sanctuary.

name: World of Kungfu: Dragon & Eagle
description:
Begin your journey in World of Kungfu: Dragon & Eagle on mobile! Start your adventure with the trial version featuring Xiangyang City and its surroundings. Unlock the full experience with a one-time purchase, available either after your trial or immediately upon download.
Experience the complete PC version on mobile! Journey from Bashu to Jiangdong and the Central Plains. Discover branching storylines and master diverse martial arts styles!

name: Shadow of the Depth
description: Shadow of the Depth is a top-down action roguelike set in a dark medieval fantasy world. You'll take on the role of a warrior, assassin, mage, and other characters as you navigate dungeons of light and shadow to root out the monsters that ravage your home. Be prepared to step into the depths before you!

name: Gig Life Tycoon
description: Struggling to make ends meet in the urban jungle is tough, but when you're responsible for providing for your loved ones back home, the stakes are even higher. Welcome to our survival simulation game, where you take on the role of a migrant worker in a bustling metropolis. Day after day, you hustle to survive by taking on different gig jobs, each one bringing you closer to your goal of securing a better life for your family.

name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
description: This is a multiplayer battle royale action game where players fight with realistic firearms and explosives to be the last survivor on a shrinking battlefield.

name: Xeno Command
description:
Welcome aboard Xeno Command, a real-time strategy offline game fused with roguelike elements. Here you can lead a strong army with powerful heroes to defend the galaxy against Alien invasion in the challenging battles.

In the era of interstellar colonization, planets are in crisis. Heroes from different factions stand out to lead powerful armies against aliens and rescue the sufferers. You, the savior of the galaxy, are going to be the hero. Lead your army and combat alien invasions!

name: Meow Hunter
description:
Meow Hunter is a pixel side-scrolling action RPG featuring adorable cat characters. It combines classic roguelike elements with the exhilarating combat experiences of platformer games.

In this meow-velous universe, you'll become a bounty hunter taking on missions across various planets in a space adventure to find energy and resources. Every hunt offers a fresh experience with a touch of retro arcade fun. Ready for it? The battle is set to unfold!

name: Tavern Tale
description:
Tavern Tale is an indie action RPG that blends cute 3D fantasy charm with dark roguelike adventure. The entire world has been sealed into a mysterious cube by an evil witch. Her mobs roam everywhere.
But in a hidden corner stands a warm little tavern built by the dwarf Hank and his friends—the only safe shelter left inside the cube.

name: PlatyGuard: Swarm Slayer
description: PlatyGuard: Swarm Slayer is a 2D action roguelike platformer RPG set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, infused with biopunk and dark sci-fi flair. Survive the chaos, clash with mutant foes, and explore mysterious sites in this indie adventure!

name: Soul Knight
description: In a time of guns and swords, the magic stone that maintains the balance of the world is stolen by high-tech aliens. The world is hanging on a thin thread. It all depends on you retrieving the magical stone…" We honestly can't keep making up more tales of the magic stone. Let's just find some alien minions and shoot 'em up!

name: Otherworld Legends
description:
Otherworld Legends is a pixel roguelike action RPG. Master heroes of your choice, craft uniquely broken builds, and hack & pummel through a myriad of dungeons in a thrilling rampage.
You are the warrior we've been waiting for. Here you will be able to:
• Explore beautiful otherworlds like tranquil bamboo grooves, zen patios, grand underworld dungeon tombs or dreamy mirage palaces. 
• Master heroes with fiery temper and overwhelming power.

name: Fallout Shelter Online
description: Set in the award-winning Fallout universe, Fallout Shelter Online is an evolution of the original strategy RPG, with all-new hero teams, gameplay, and PvP.

name: Dumb Ways to Die
description: Enjoy 82 hilarious minigames as you attempt to collect all the charmingly dumb characters for your train station, achieve high scores and unlock the famous music video that started it all!

name: Soul Knight Prequel
description: Soul Knight Prequel is a pixel-art action RPG featuring loot farming. Slash monsters to upgrade your power, or party up for treasure against the odds. Our newest ARPG continues to feature Soul Knight's familiar posse of chibi characters, while satiating the fans' hunger for more lore and quests!

name: Exhausted Man
description:
Exhausted Man is a physics-comedy game, where you help an exhausted person get through a night that is crucial to him/her. Do everything while lying down, decorate the room to your taste, get tonight's ending through your choices.

Features:
• The protagonist can only crawl…
• The goal is clear tonight! But there is so much to do…
• You can take a nap anytime…zZZ

name: m00m world
description:
Welcome to m00m world:

Build and decorate your own shipping-container home, hang out with friends, and play chill mini-games in a cozy cyberpunk MMO. Explore player-made worlds, team up for quests, and show your style with Digital Double™—fashion you can wear in real life.

name: Sniper Siege: Defend & Destroy
description:
Experience the ultimate sniper adventure as you pick off enemies with a bolt action sniper rifle in diverse environments.
Immerse yourself in thrilling stealth missions across urban jungles and treacherous mountain ranges, adapting your strategies to eliminate targets with precision.
Master the art of marksmanship with authentic bolt action sniper rifles, executing perfect kills from incredible distances.

name: Color Clash
description:
In this card game players fight between red and blue to capture territory by coloring the arena.
Each card unleashes unique units with special abilities to outmanoeuvre opponents and dominate the game.

name: Chess Online - Clash of Kings
description: A classic board game of chess

name: Hex Warriors
description:
Revolutionary RTS: Your Deck Commands a Million-Strong Army!

A brand-new Hexagonal Card Warfare
Dominate the hexa battlefield where every tile flip sparks strategic revolution:
▷ Gold Rush: Secure mines for explosive growth
▷ Legendary Card: Summon legendary heroes to reverse tides

name: Terraria
description: The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep into cavernous expanses, test your mettle in combat, or construct your own city!

name: Boom Beach
description: Come with a plan or leave in defeat! Welcome to Boom Beach, an epic combat strategy game where your brains and your troop’s brawn fight against the evil Blackguard. Attack bases to free enslaved islanders or create a task force with friends and other players to take on the enemy together, all while exploring and unlocking secrets of this beautiful archipelago. Scout, plan, then BOOM THE BEACH!

name: Clash Royale
description: Clash Royale is a real-time multiplayer game starring the Royales, your favourite Clash characters and much, much more. Collect and upgrade dozens of cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defenses you know and love, as well as the Royales: Princes, Knights, Baby Dragons and more. Knock the enemy King and Princesses from their towers to defeat your opponents and win Trophies, Crowns and glory in the Arena.

name: Squad Busters
description: Squad Busters is a fast-paced, multiplayer action-strategy game, where 10 players battle to collect the most gems within a shrinking map. Players build, evolve, and manage squads featuring characters from Clash of Clans, Brawl Stars, and other franchises, utilizing unique abilities to defeat monsters, bosses, and other players in ~4-minute matches.

name: Monster Survivors
description:
Embark on an Epic Survival Adventure!

In a world overrun by monstrous creatures, only the bravest can survive. "Monster Survivors: Last Stand" is a thrilling action-packed game that challenges you to outlive the hordes of terrifying monsters. With its unique blend of strategy and fast-paced combat, this game puts your survival skills to the ultimate test.

name: Sea Force
description: The game integrates the strategy gameplay of "Auto Chess", with ever-changing battle situations, each step testing strategy, and every voyage being a new journey.

name: Switching Heroes
description:
Switching Heroes is an idle RPG featuring fast-paced combat and real-time hero switching.

Swap heroes to unleash flashy skills, defeat enemies, and progress through stages automatically or manually. Grow stronger by upgrading stats and mastering strategic hero switches in increasingly challenging battles.

name: Jetpack Master
description:
Fly high! Soar to the finish line in this thrilling action game!

Swipe the screen to control your flight and reach the goal. It's challenging, but fun!

name: Spring Lancer
description:
Tap and drag on the screen to aim your spear.
Lift your finger and the spear fires in that direction!
Use the spear-sticking wall mechanic to control its movement with finesse.
Take down every enemy to clear the stage!

name: Woodturning 3D
description:
The best woodturning simulator.
Complete customer orders.
Turn a piece of wood into the given shape.
Cut (carve), polish, paint and add a stencil to your work.
Earn money and improve your room.

name: Sand Loop
description:
Tap, collect, and relax!

Experience the soothing satisfaction of flowing sand in Sand Loop — the ultimate relaxing tap game. Send buckets along a moving conveyor belt to collect sand by color, uncovering stunning artworks as grains fall with smooth, realistic physics. Every tap brings the picture to life as it gradually collapses in a cascade of color and motion. Simple to play, yet endlessly rewarding.

name: Cup Heroes
description:
Cup Heroes: Join the Adventure of a Lifetime!

Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen! This fun-filled adventure will keep you hooked with its charming characters, exciting gameplay, and endless challenges.

name: Archery Clash!
description: Enter the thrilling arena of Archery Clash, where the essence of shooter sports and cold weapon mastery culminates in the ultimate showdown. Embrace your role as a legendary archer, mastering the bow, spear, and axe to outsmart and outmaneuver your adversaries. With every precise throw and strategic strike, engage in epic 3D duels that test your precision, strategy, and archery skills. Are you ready to claim your victory and ascend to the ranks of the bowmasters?

name: Epic Plane Evolution
description: Prepare for an exhilarating aerial adventure in Epic Plane Evolution, where your piloting skills and strategic upgrades determine how far your aircraft can soar. Launch your plane, navigate through diverse terrains, and evolve your aircraft to achieve maximum distance. Whether you're a casual gamer or a flight enthusiast, this game offers a captivating blend of action and strategy.

name: Mob Control
description: Mob Control delivers thrilling tower defense action where you grow your mob, deploy powerful champions, and crush enemy bases. Unlock collectible cards, conquer exciting modes, and climb the Champions League. Face new challenges, earn rewards, and discover fresh content as you rise to tower defense supremacy!

name: Gear Fight!
description:
Gear Fight! A brand new type of puzzle-adventure game!

It's time to build a well oiled machine to take down these pesky enemies! First, place down some gears. Then, put your newly constructed factory to the test versus all of the evil enemies!

name: My Talking Hank: Islands
description: Dive into the fun virtual pet simulation where adventure and cuteness collide. Explore an island paradise, take care of your adorable pet friend, Talking Hank, and discover animals around every corner. Dress up Hank in his favorite outfits, design the treehouse, and show your style. Feed your goofy dog with funny foods, clean his teeth, and put him to sleep. Unlock new areas and relax on the island simulation adventure. Befriend a lion, a turtle, a snow leopard, and others.

name: Sea of Conquest: Pirate War
description: Customize your ship, command your crew, and conquer the seas! Engage in epic battles and treasure hunts. Become the top pirate!

name: Avakin Life
description: Start a life without limits in Avakin Life now! Discover unlimited ways to be you. Enter a virtual world of endless opportunities, a wardrobe packed with the latest fashion, your dream home in every location imaginable, and new adventures, parties and events happening every day!

name: Guns of Glory: Lost Island
description: Get ready for the next stage of warfare with the free strategy MMO Guns of Glory! GoG’s thrilling multiplayer RTS and RPG gameplay lets you raise your own powerful army, to shoot down enemies and team up with friends from around the globe.

name: Civilization: Eras & Allies 2K
description: Civilization: Eras & Allies is a real-time 4X strategy MMO developed by 2K. Players lead an empire through history, managing resources, researching technology, and commanding legendary historical leaders in real-time battles. The game features seasonal competitive play, large-scale multiplayer alliances, and strategic territory conquest across an evolving world map.

name: Civilization: Eras & Allies 2K
description: Civilization: Eras & Allies is a real-time 4X strategy MMO developed by 2K. Players lead an empire through history, managing resources, researching technology, and commanding legendary historical leaders in real-time battles. The game features seasonal competitive play, large-scale multiplayer alliances, and strategic territory conquest across an evolving world map.

name: Matchington Mansion
description: Matchington Mansion is a match-3 puzzle game with a house renovation theme.  Players can not only play match-3 levels but also use the rewards earned from completing levels to decorate their house in the game.

name: Stellacept Online
description:
Stellacept Online is a beautiful game in which you can inflict devastating combos by taping your screen at the right moment, or unleash a terrible power with the Burst Points earned by beating enemies.
Chat in real time with other players to cooperate and to help each other.

name: Project Makeover
description: Project Makeover is a match-3 puzzle game with a fashion twist.  In addition to playing match-3 levels, players can use the rewards earned from completing levels to dress up characters and decorate houses within the game.

name: Modern Community
description: Modern Community is a match-3 puzzle game with a community renovation theme.  Besides playing match-3 levels, players can use the rewards earned from completing levels to decorate the entire community within the game.

name: Lucky Defense!
description: Epic Clash of Survival! A Casual Tower Defense Game!

name: IZANAGI ONLINE
description: Full-scale ninja action RPG with characters designed by Takashi Okazaki. Features over 100 quests, 4 distinct classes, and online co-op play.

name: Bushi Navi Global
description:
Bushi Navi Global is a one stop solution for all Bushiroad TCG players.

Locate events near you, get your match pairing, report your match result and even check your previous match results all via Bushi Navi app.

Personalize your profile with titles earned from attending Bushiroad official events!

name: Seekers Notes: Hidden Objects
description: Journey to the cursed city—find hidden objects and solve secret mysteries.

name: Cooking Diary® Restaurant Game
description: Cook tasty food and build a culinary empire in this crazy time-management game!

name: Ship It Right
description: Step into the building of Ship It Right, a game-based assessment set in the heart of a bustling factory. You’ll take on the role of a key player in the shipping process—facing unexpected tasks, racing against time, and navigating a constantly changing environment filled with surprises, decisions, and opportunities.

name: Chef & Friends: Cooking Game
description: PLAY AS A VIRTUOSO CHEF IN THIS COOKING GAME, RENOVATE RESTAURANTS & CAFES!

name: ABC
description: ABC

name: Ravenhill: Find Hidden Objects
description: Seek and find hidden objects, play match-3 puzzles, and solve the city mystery.

name: Nudoku
description:
A Sudoku puzzle with a choice of different numeric systems, symbol and picture sets  additional to standard western digits to represent the 9 different items in the puzzle. As a in-app purchase, there is a chinese letter tutorial mode, where the items are letters from the qian zi wen primer in simplified and traditional writing, with basic english translations and simple text-to-speech output for pronounciation.
Other In-App-Purchases provide a few additional image sets.

name: Dress Up Stylist- Fashion Game
description: Become a fashion super stylist with dress up & makeup styles in this girls game

name: Super Wedding Fashion Stylist
description: Dress up, do makeup & design weddings as a wedding designer & stylist!

name: SAKURA School Simulator
description: This is a simulation game where you live in the fictional town of "Sakura Town." You can talk to people to raise their affection levels or complete missions. Additionally, it features action and shooting elements.

name: TamDomi
description: Experience the beloved Vietnamese card game Tam Cúc, now beautifully crafted for your iPhone and iPad. TamDomi brings this traditional strategy game to life with smooth gameplay, vibrant visuals, and the ability to play with friends or challenge smart computer opponents.

name: Prison Gang Wars
description: Crime game set in a prison where you try to take over the yard

name: Choose Your Story - Decisions
description: Experience fame, drama & more in this interactive story game. Make your choice!

name: School Bus Simulator Drive 3D
description: Learn to drive and park a school bus, and become the ultimate school bus driver!

name: Driving Academy: Car Games
description: Ace your driving skills with our realistic car driving & parking simulator game

name: Driving Academy 2: 3D Car Game
description: Learn to Drive! Get your license now! Play Driving School Car Simulator

name: Robbery Madness
description: Thief simulator game with cartoon graphics and fun elements.

name: Robbery Madness 2
description: An action-packed thief simulator with cartoon graphics. Featuring theft, magic, weapons, and supernatural creatures.

name: Homematch
description: Match-3 puzzle game with interior design meta.

name: Good Coffee, Great Coffee
description: Coffee simulation cooking game.

name: Good Pizza, Great Pizza
description: Pizza cooking simulation game.

name: ShapeFlip
description: Test your geometrical manipulation skills in this puzzle arcade game that will really make you use your brain power. Pick the correct shape that matches the one in the middle. But be careful as the other one is flipped! And don't take too long as you only have five seconds to figure out which shape, left or right, is correct!

name: Sky: Children of the Light
description: Sky: Children of the Light is a peaceful, award-winning MMO from the creators of Journey. Explore a beautifully-animated kingdom across seven realms and create enriching memories with other players in this delightful puzzle-adventure game.

name: DontSpam
description: Tilt to move, tap to shoot. Shoot the cube to move and rotate it. Juggle the cube within the screen boundary. But... DONT SPAM!!! You'll lose control of the cube! Compete with your friends! Rotate the cube the most or keep the cube alive the longest!

name: Chessgeon
description: Chess meets dungeons! Help Morphy save his queen as you strategise and overcome the many floors of the chessgeon! Transform into various chess pieces and utilise their unique movements. Stack transformations into combos to gain the upper hand. Defeat the boss to save your queen!

name: Harvest Moon: Mad Dash
description: A fast-paced farming frenzy! Harvest, fish, milk, and more as you fulfill orders to complete each level, but watch out for molten lava, raging boars, and other obstacles! Can you try to clear all the levels to restore the broken lighthouse?

name: Harvest Moon: Light of Hope
description: It will be up to you to help rebuild the town and save the lighthouse...but it won't be easy! Nevertheless, with some hard work growing crops, tending livestock, and gathering materials for repairs, you will be able to make new friends, start a family, revive the lighthouse, and save the town, your new home!

name: Harvest Moon: Seeds of Memories
description: In Harvest Moon: Seeds of Memories, fans will enjoy the return of cows, sheep, and chickens to help their farm, horses to ride, and dogs to raise as pets. New to the game is the bobcat, a wild animal that, over time, players can befriend and make into their loyal pet!

name: CodyCross
description:
CodyCross is here to introduce you to a fun new spelling puzzle and trivia crossword game.

Start your journey with CodyCross, a friendly alien from the planet COD-X who came to Earth to learn about our planet. Learn about interesting and fun facts as you play through the levels and encounter unique, themed crossword puzzles.

name: Everyday Puzzles
description:
Everyday Puzzles - Multiple Games in One App
A hub of word puzzles and brain teasers to keep you entertained daily
Free daily puzzles plus unlimited access to our entire calendar archive—your puzzle fun never ends

name: The Cursed Castle - Online RPG
description: Indie roguelike where you wander in an apparently abandoned castle and fight creatures to get loot and therefore stronger to beat stronger creatures.

name: Hay Day
description:
Farm With Friends and Family
You don’t have to be from a farm to be a great farmer. Hay Day lets you get back to nature and experience the simple life of working the land. It’s a special game set in a real special place. Food grows free, people smile and the animals are always happy to see you. It never rains here, but the crops never die. And if you’re craving a little bacon, one of the pigs will be happy to fry some up for you. After all, what are pigs... oops, we mean neighbors for?

name: mo.co
description: mo.co is a fast-paced, top-down, action role-playing game (ARPG) where players take on the role of specialized "hunters" hired to explore, battle, and capture chaotic monsters across parallel worlds. The gameplay involves traversing, fighting, and looting to obtain, upgrade, and customize gear to suit various playstyles. The game emphasizes a "co-op" experience, allowing players to join with friends or strangers to take down massive bosses in "Rift" raids.

name: Obsessed: Trace
description: Haunted by loss and guilt, Arya is lost between reality and delusion as he tries to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Valeria, the daughter of his late friend that worked at his shop

name: Project CCTV
description: Play as squad captain of the Critical Containment Threat Verification division and watch live surveillance feeds from CCTV to report any anomalies and survive the night.

name: Brawl Stars
description:
3V3 AND BATTLE ROYALE
Time to BRAWL! Team up with your friends and get ready for epic multiplayer MAYHEM! Jump into your favorite game mode and play quick matches with your friends. Shoot 'em up, blow 'em up, punch 'em out and win the BRAWL.

name: Obsessed: Night Shift
description: A PSX Inspired horror game where you must work and cook at a shop late at night and the horrors that comes with it.
