name: Numberblocks World
description: Numberblocks World is an educational video-on-demand and subscription app for children aged 3+ that teaches foundational math through over 100 animated episodes and interactive games. Created by Blue Zoo Animations and Alphablocks Ltd, it features subitizing, counting, and number-tracing games to help master numbers 1-100 in a, fun, visual, and interactive environment.

name: Asphalt 8
description: Asphalt 8 is a high-octane arcade racing game packed with real supercars, intense stunts, and breathtaking tracks around the world. Drift, boost, and launch off ramps at extreme speeds in solo or multiplayer races, with constant events and upgrades keeping the adrenaline pumping.

name: Pirate Ships・Build and Fight
description: Load your ship with cannons and crew, and fight against other players online!

name: Human: Fall Flat
description: Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 4 players. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded. Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded.

name: Pirate Ships・Build and Fight
description: Load your ship with cannons and crew, and fight against other players online!

name: Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight
description: Grab the control yoke of a warplane and jump into the battlefields of World War 2 in this thrilling combat flight action game. In each of the campaigns for USA, Great Britain, USSR, Germany and Japan you will assume the role of a pilot and squadron leader of an elite air force unit, established for the most dangerous and strategic missions that can turn the tide of war.

name: Pocket Love
description: Pocket Love is a decoration and dress up simulation game.

name: Hytale
description: Hytale is a sandbox RPG with a procedurally generated, block-based fantasy world. Players explore unique biomes, dungeons, and creatures, as well as play Hypixel-style minigames. Early Access offers free exploration, creativity, and an active community to shape the game alongside the developers.

name: Jurassic World: The Game
description:
Jurassic World™: The Game, the official mobile game based on this summer’s epic action-adventure. Bring to life more than 300 colossal dinosaurs from the new film and challenge your opponents in earth-shaking battles. Construct the theme park of tomorrow in this unrivaled build-and-battle dinosaur experience.

In order to build a winning Battle Arena team, you’ll need to design the most efficient and effective park, one that will allow your dinosaurs to thrive and evolve.

name: Disney Magic Kingdoms
description: Create the Disney Park of your dreams, filled with beloved Disney, Pixar and Star Wars characters, exciting attractions and special events! Join over 90 million players worldwide who have embraced their inner child building their own magical place on mobile.

name: A Lunar Crisis
description:
Can you survive where no one is coming to save you? Lunar Crisis puts you in command of four stranded astronauts, fighting against time, isolation, and failing systems. Your mission: repair a damaged ship on a dead moon—and get everyone home alive.

This is more than a survival game. Lunar Crisis is a test of resourcefulness and pressure management, crafted to teach probabilistic thinking. Monitor, repair… or perish.

Lunar Crisis is volume 2 of the Mental Model Minis Series.

name: Desolation Farm
description:
Can you thrive where few survive? Desolation Farm challenges you to build and sustain a farm in a near-future world ravaged by relentless disasters. With scarce resources and unforgiving conditions, every choice matters—one mistake could leave you with nothing but dust and ruin. 

This is more than a farming game. Desolation Farm is a test of foresight and resilience, designed to sharpen your second-order thinking. Plan, adapt, and survive…

name: Decision Diner
description:
Welcome to Decision Diner—where every choice is on the menu.

In Decision Diner, you’re racing against the clock to build the ultimate restaurant. Where do you spend? New tables? Faster service? Better equipment? Choose wisely—every decision affects the next. One mistake could bankrupt you.

Prioritize, adapt, and climb from chaos to five-star success before time runs out.

name: I Did Not Buy This Ticket
description:
Weep for the dead! Ride a nightmarish bus whose destination depends on how you choose to face your traumas.

Candelaria travels from one funeral to the next, weeping for the departed she has never met in life, going on long night treks that keep her insomnia at bay.

When she comes across a bus ticket she did not buy to the mysterious Eigengrau Line, she is forced to confront traumas from the past and define a new course for her life.

name: Kingdom Rush Tower Defense TD
description: Kingdom Rush is a tower defense game developed by Ironhide Game Studio. In the game's medieval fantasy setting, players take control of a general serving under King Denas of Linirea, who must defend the land from an onslaught of evil monsters.

name: Hidden Tales
publisherName: Leap Bilişim Teknolojileri ve Yazılım Ticaret Anonim Şirketi
description: Discover an immersive hidden object game that blends challenge and calm as you explore mysterious locations. Whether you're a fan of iSpy puzzles, love solving clues, or enjoy search and find games, Hidden Tales has something special for you.

name: Rummy Rush
description: P2P Rummy card game

name: Gin Rummy Stars
description: P2P Rummy card game

name: Bloxie - Block Puzzle
description: Bloxie – Block Puzzle is a block-based puzzle game where players place different shapes onto a grid to complete lines and clear space. The game is level-based and focuses on spatial reasoning, planning, and efficient placement of blocks.

name: Zombees Rush
description: Zombees Rush is an action arcade game where players move through stages while avoiding or defeating zombie-themed obstacles and enemies. The gameplay emphasizes quick reactions, movement control, and progressing through increasingly challenging levels.

name: Zombees: Shooter
description: Zombees: Shooter is an action game where players use weapons to shoot incoming waves of zombie-themed enemies. The game is level-based and focuses on aiming, timing, and survival against progressively tougher opponents.

name: Tomb Raider
description:
Before there was the Tomb Raider, there was Lara Croft; twenty-one years old and shipwrecked on her first archaeological expedition. To escape the mysterious isle of Yamatai, she must push far beyond her limits, leave innocence behind and be reborn a legend.

Explore Yamatai’s ancient ruins, unlock its riddles and fight for survival against its murderous inhabitants.

name: Cook & Merge - Merge Game
description: Welcome to Bakers Valley! Your mission is to merge delicious food to help Kate, a talented chef, save Bakers Valley and all its beloved family restaurants from the exploits of evil-minded Rex Hunter! Lucky Granny, an ex-spy and keeper of secrets, is on your side! Explore the secrets & gossip of the beachside town and discover how you can help rescue every restaurant & building in Bakers Valley before the developers get their hands on this jewel of a town!

name: World of Liberty Adventure 4
description: Liberty Lane and her pals are back for adventure four! This fun, exciting, interactive storybook follows Liberty Lane, her dog Ellie, her toy eagle Georgie, and her model plane Truman as they set out to explore how Boston, Massachusetts connects with the world — this time, all the way to Barcelona, Spain!

name: King's Bounty: Crossworlds
description: King’s Bounty: Crossworlds is the stand alone expansion for the famous King's Bounty: Armored Princess role-playing game that contains an improved version of it, two additional campaigns and world editor.

name: King's Bounty: Warriors of the North
description: The new tale takes place in the familiar world of Endoria featured in the previous games, but begins in the Viking lands, which the celebrated hero Bill Gilbert never visited during his famous quest in King’s Bounty: The Legend.

name: King's Bounty: Dark Side
description: For the first time in King’s Bounty series, players will be able to choose their hero’s race as well as class. Become a fearless Orcs warrior, lead and heal your troops as a Demoness, or use dark magic as a fearsome Vampire.

name: King's Bounty: Armored Princess
description: layers will take on the role of Princess Amelie who travels around the world of Teana and searches for the renowned knight, and her mentor. The new character, the Princess, will encounter horrible creatures, huge monstrous bosses and a new race, the bloodthirsty Lizards. The player has many options to resist these new enemies. Various new skills and characteristics of Amelie as well as her chance to fly will help her overcome the hordes attacking the kingdom.

name: Wordyz
description: Wordyz is a daily word puzzle game that challenges players to think both linguistically and categorically. Unlike traditional word games that focus on a single word, Wordyz presents a unique "funnel" format—three words of increasing length (5, 6, and 7 letters) that all connect to a common theme.

name: KARDS
description: KARDS is the World War II Card Game, which combines traditional CCG gameplay with innovative mechanics inspired by classic strategy games and real battlefield tactics.

name: King's Bounty: The Legend
description: King's Bounty: The Legend is an adventure game with tactical turn-based battles and role-playing elements.

name: Space Rangers HD: A War Apart
description: Space adventure, open world RPG, strategy, arcade, quest and more!

name: Soldiers: Heroes of World War II - Enhanced Edition
description: The first installment in the real-time tactics series that would become known as Men of War, now refreshed and enhanced! Take command of American, British, Soviet, or German forces and fight on the battlefields of World War II in 32 single-player missions or with others in PvP and co-op sessions

name: Glorbs
description: Glorbs is a physics puzzle game about strategy, precision and timing, where careful control matters as much as speed. You guide small "glorbs" to the endzone using your finger as an attractor (or a mouse or game controller) while trying to keep them safe.

name: Fitopoly
description: Fitopoly is a mobile fitness application that encourages physical activity through gamified challenges and location-based progress tracking. Users earn points and advance by completing workouts and movement goals, promoting consistent exercise and healthy habits.

name: Food Gang
description: Food Gang is a fast and explosive multiplayer brawl where crazy food heroes battle with guns in 2v2 arenas.

name: Zoo Life: Animal Park Game
description: Mobile zoo simulation game.

name: PowerWash Simulator
description: Wash away your worries with the soothing sounds of high-pressure water. Fire up your power washer and blast away every speck of dirt and grime, all with the simple satisfaction of power-washing to a sparkling finish.

name: Super Penguins
description: Choose from a number of adorable penguins to run, jump, and fly your way to victory against the evil octopuses, collecting delicious fish and rescuing as many other penguins as possible along the way.

name: Adventure Town
description: Adventure Town is a charming new game with an fun mix of city-building with light combat elements. Rebuild your town and attract new Heroes to fight for your cause. Send Heroes to defeat monsters and explore dungeons in surrounding lands. Quests will guide, amuse and reward you. Start on this fantastic journey to restore greatness to your world and banish the forces of darkness!

name: Home Street: Virtual House Sim
description:
Design and decorate your dream sims home and life, building in full 3D games!

Build an avakin sim and design a space in game that reflects your dream style!

Enjoy your virtual town and make friends with real sim players from around the world in this life simulator game!

name: Naruto Online
description: Naruto Online Official RPG Game is a web game which is based on the content of the "Naruto" universe. Recall all the story of "Naruto" and experience it yourself with various ninja ready to help you in your path. All fans of "Naruto" will surely be interested in this game and will find it very entertaining.

name: SMiniz
description: Play a heart-fluttering Match-3 puzzle with your 'Bias'.

name: Snake Rivals - io Snakes Games
description:
Slither your snake around in this fun 3D multiplayer snake io game - Become the biggest snake, worm or serpiente and don’t let the other snakes and worms hit! 

-Snake Rivals io multiplayer 3D snake games we challenge you to become the biggest snakes in our fun io games! 
-It’s a new take on the classic snake games with a multiplayer .io games twist!

-Slither into Classic games io mode and swipe to move your snake or worm and eat as many apples as you can in fun, stunning 3D games.

name: Food Street – Restaurant Game
description:
Welcome to Food Street, a free restaurant and cafe management story world!
You are the Master Chef of your own cafe, bakery, diner or restaurant! 

Show the world you are the rising super chef!

Visit friends, trade food items with other my restaurant owners around cafe world and play together in friendly online competitions in my town! Be the food tycoon!

Keep all the customers in food town happy as you bake, cook and do even more in Food Street, your master chef story in cafe land!

name: X-Out - Alien Outbreak
description:
They pulled you out of the Dark. Your happy place of nowhere. Locked you up. But now … Your strength is coming back! This is your chance ... GET OUT, X!

Free the darkness and escape from a secret laboratory in this fast paced jump'n'run outbreak challenge. Unleash your alien powers with supernatural upgrades and make it to the top as fast as possible. Be first, or the humans will be!

name: Wingfall
description: This game offers thrilling vertical shoot ’em up action with classic arcade combat and modern visuals. Players face endless enemy waves, with roguelike progression providing random rewards and upgrades. Collect fragments to unlock and enhance warplanes. Epic boss battles and diverse worlds—from WWII to sci-fi, aquatic, and alien—challenge skill and precision.

name: Lily's Garden
description: Lily’s Garden is a match-3 puzzle game combined with garden renovation mechanics. Players solve blast-style puzzle levels to earn resources used to repair and decorate a garden. The game includes a narrative about the main character, Lily, interacting with other characters through dialogue scenes. Gameplay features level-based puzzles, customization options, and story progression.

name: Kingdom Go!
publisherName: JIUZHOU CHUANGYOU NETWORK (HONG KONG) COMPANY LIMITED
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating leisure of the Three Kingdoms card game, where you can command armies, conquer lands, and unveil your inner hero.

name: I Love Burger - Shop & Farm
description:
สนุกไปกับการสร้างร้านและทำฟาร์ม พร้อมกับของตกแต่งกว่า 1,000 ชิ้น!! และสร้างแฟรนไชส์เบอร์เกอร์สุดปัง ชวนเพื่อนมาสร้างอาณาจักรเบอร์เกอร์พร้อมกันได้แล้ววันนี้

◆ ร่วมกันเปิดร้านแฟรนไชส์กับเพื่อน
◆ มีธีมตกแต่งให้เลือกมากกว่า 80 แบบ
◆ พนักงานพาร์ทไทม์
◆ จ้างพนักงานสุดพิเศษ
◆ และอีกมากมาย !!

name: Hero Clash
publisherName: JIUZHOU CHUANGYOU NETWORK (HONG KONG) COMPANY LIMITED
description:
To save this cruel continent, you must rise to the challenge of endurance and intelligence!
Here's a tip for you: the easiest way to overcome each puzzle is to find the quickest solution. Use your wisdom to seize the right moment and, most importantly, execute with precision.

name: Aurcus Online
description:
"Aurcus Online" is a 3D MMORPG for smartphones featuring Non-targeting combat system. 
Apart from the targeting system (select the target for automatic attacks) of the usual MMORPG (Online RPG), the non-targeting system allows you to hit the enemy in the striking range.
With this non-targeting system, you are able to enjoy even more exhilarating experience, and more real time-like and exciting battles in this MMORPG (Online RPG).

name: Zombie State
description:
Dive into a thrilling post-apocalyptic world in this intense roguelike shooter! Zombie State combines fast-paced FPS action with unique character abilities. Fight through diverse zones, from desolate cities to secret labs, as you encounter evolved zombie threats.
    Roguelike Elements: Every run is unique with randomized skills.
    Diverse Bosses: Face off against giant, mutated monsters.
    Weapon Customization: Unlock and upgrade a massive arsenal.

name: Gecko GO
description: An exciting casual game where players control a cute gecko to run, jump, and avoid obstacles to reach the finish line. Fun for all ages.

name: 2 Player Games - Offline
description: 2-4 player games on one device.

name: Darkstar : idle RPG
description: Spaceship battles in outer space are always a topic that can bring great excitement to many players. To meet these desires, Darkstar—Idle RPG will be developed according to this style of play. This attractive game allows players to operate their spaceship to fight in vast space. The game has also prepared a special setting where everything around is only darkness and sparkling stars.

name: Deep Sky Derelicts
description: Deep Sky Derelicts is an original combination of turn-based strategy and RPG, enriched with tactical card combat and popular roguelike elements. Explore derelict alien ships, fight, loot and upgrade your gear, all in distinctive retro-futuristic comic book aesthetic style.

name: X-Clash
publisherName: JIUZHOU CHUANGYOU NETWORK (HONG KONG) COMPANY LIMITED
description:
The Evil Void tears the continent asunder, while the Undead Plague devours the last remnants of civilization! In this dual apocalypse, only the worthy shall rebuild the realm!

To survive this cataclysm, you must master both strategic command and survival instinct!

name: Jackpot World™ - Slots Casino
description: Simulated casino slots game featuring themed slot machines. Spin reels to win virtual coins and unlock new content. Intended for adults only. No real money gambling, and no opportunity to win real money or prizes.

name: Difference - Find & Spot Them
description: Differences is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you compare pictures to spot the differences. Find hidden details, train your observation and focus, and enjoy the challenge at your own pace.

name: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Cold War
description: The legendary Men of War RTS series has reached the cold war era. Take command of U.S. or Soviet soldiers, controlling vast armies with the military decisions down to you. Claim victory in dynamic singleplayer and co-op campaigns or challenge fellow strategists in online multiplayer!

name: Zombie Harbor
description:
Survive the outbreak in this fast-paced offline first-person shooter! Set in an abandoned harbor overrun by the undead, Zombie Harbor challenges you to fight through relentless waves of zombies in a post-apocalyptic world.
    Pure Offline Action: Play anytime without an internet connection.
    Deadly Arsenal: Use assault rifles, shotguns, and machine guns.
    Weapon Upgrades: Enhance damage and accuracy to stay alive.
    Atmospheric Locations: Explore ruined docks and haunted city zones.

name: Men of War: Condemned Heroes
description: Command a Soviet penal battalion in this standalone real-time tactics game from the Men of War series. Based on true events, Condemned Heroes delivers brutal, story-driven missions across the Eastern Front – where every order, bullet, and life matters.

name: Death Stranding Standard Digital Edition
description:
Sam Bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the Death Stranding. Carrying the disconnected remnants of our future in his hands, he embarks on a journey to reconnect the shattered world one step at a time.

With spectral creatures plaguing the landscape, and humanity on the verge of a mass extinction, it’s up to Sam to journey across the ravaged continent and save mankind from impending annihilation.

name: Men of War: Red Tide
description: Red Tide blends deep RTS tactics with the raw intensity of third-person combat. Created in collaboration with author Alexander Zorich, this standalone expansion tells the story of the Black Coats – Soviet Naval Infantry famed for their ruthless precision in the Black Sea campaigns.

name: Cash Rally - Slots Casino Game
description: Simulated casino slots game featuring themed slot machines. Spin reels to win virtual coins and unlock new content. Intended for adults only. No real money gambling, and no opportunity to win real money or prizes.

name: Men of War: Vietnam
description: Men of War: Vietnam brings the acclaimed real-time tactics series into a new theater of war – the jungles of Southeast Asia, 1968. Experience the chaos of the Vietnam War through two story-driven campaigns that reveal both sides of the conflict.

name: Men of War™
description: Men of War is a stunning Real-Time Strategy game that takes place during the height of World War II. Intense battles span Europe and North Africa as gamers play as Soviet, Allied or German forces across 19 massive single-player missions.

name: Word Search - Crossword Game
description: Word Search is a casual word puzzle game where players find and mark hidden words by swiping letters on a grid in multiple directions. The game focuses on vocabulary building, pattern recognition, and concentration, with no time pressure, violence, or gambling elements. Optional daily challenges and rewards provide light progression, while the overall experience is designed for calm, educational, and entertaining gameplay suitable for a wide audience.

name: Left to Survive
description:
Left to Survive is a post-apocalyptic shooter blending intense zombie survival with base building. Fight through hordes of undead in PvE missions, or test your skills in competitive 1v1 and 2v2 PvP battles.

Key Features:

    Zombie Mayhem: Use a vast arsenal to clear infested areas.

    Base Defense: Build and fortify your sanctuary.

    Helicopter Raids: Attack rival bases for resources.

    Epic Bosses: Defeat massive mutants.

Survive the apocalypse and dominate the wasteland!

name: Men of War: Assault Squad
description: Men of War: Assault Squad delivers a deeply tactical WWII experience, blending large-scale strategy with intense, hands-on combat. Fight across multiple fronts – from European countryside to Pacific jungles and command every unit and every bullet on the battlefield.

name: Spider Solitaire - Card Games
description: Spider Solitaire is a digital version of the classic Spider Solitaire card game, where players arrange cards in descending order by suit to clear the board. The game offers adjustable difficulty levels using one, two, or four suits and includes optional features such as hints, undo, and customization of cards and backgrounds. It is designed for relaxation, focus, and logical thinking, with optional daily challenges and events that add structured goals without changing the core gameplay.

name: Men of War: Assault Squad 2
description: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 expands the real-time tactics series with new skirmish missions, massive multiplayer battles, enhanced visuals, improved AI, and full Direct Control. Command five factions across 65 maps, 250 vehicles, and 200 soldiers in one of the most detailed WWII RTS experiences.

name: Solitaire - Classic Card Games
description: Solitaire is a digital version of the classic Klondike Solitaire card game, designed for casual play and cognitive engagement. Players arrange and sort standard playing cards according to traditional Solitaire rules, with adjustable difficulty modes (Draw 1 or Draw 3), optional hints, and undo features. The game focuses on logic, attention, and strategic thinking. Optional challenges and events provide additional goals without altering the core, skill-based gameplay.

name: Cash Club Casino - Vegas Slots
description: Simulated casino slots game featuring themed slot machines. Spin reels to win virtual coins and unlock new content. Intended for adults only. No real money gambling, and no opportunity to win real money or prizes.

name: Infinite Borders
publisherName: 香港网易互动娱乐有限公司
description: Infinite Borders 的下載量超過 1000 萬次，是東亞地區最受歡迎的策略遊戲之一。當你進入遊戲時，你將回到中國歷史上動蕩的三國王朝，並有機會書寫你的史詩。你將扮演一名領主，與劉備、曹操、呂布等三國英雄並肩作戰。用不同的將軍和戰術組合組建你獨特的團隊，打敗更多的敵人，征服更多的土地。

name: Pixel Art - Color by Number
description: Pixel Art is a casual, non-competitive coloring and creativity app that allows users to color pixel-based images or create their own artwork. Users fill numbered cells with colors to complete 2D and 3D images, explore themed collections, participate in optional events, and use simple tools to enhance the coloring process.

name: Number Tiles - Match Numbers
description: Number Tiles is a fun logic puzzle in which users match pairs of identical numbers or numbers that add up to ten. With an intuitive design, smooth progression, and smart boosters, Number Tiles is a fun way to train brain and sharpen logic skills.

name: Challenge Your Friends 2Player
description: 2 player games on on device.

name: Number Sums - Numbers Game
description: Number Sums is a challenging number puzzle game that helps you train your math and logic skills. The goal is to make the sum of numbers in each row, column, and colored region be equal to the clues on the side of the board and inside the colored regions. Play Number Sums anywhere, anytime, and practice your math skills!

name: Bike 360 Flip Stunt game 3d
description: Multiplayer, super bike stunt racing against your mate or any stranger online, can’t get better than that. Take full control of your motorcycle, check the possibility of the oncoming stunt or mega ramp, and always keep an eye on your rivals, trying to whistle pass you for the ultimate bike rider glory. You don’t have to be in ultra charged mode, as some stunts require extra diligent and be smart about it.

name: Powerlust
description: Old school action RPG. Travel through an open world, design your own character class and feed your LUST for POWER by crushing your foes. Bonus replayability thanks to procedural generation, tons of abilities and items. Optional permadeath for hardcore roguelike fans!

name: Rent Please! Landlord Sim
description: This is a casual city-building and landlord simulation game. Players act as the owner to manage various residential and commercial zones for profit, while collecting tenants with unique backstories across different themed maps. The game also features a creative DIY system, allowing players to decorate their own personal homes.

name: Color Block Run - Puzzle Game
description:
Unwind with addictive, brain-teasing puzzles! 
Each level ramps up in creativity and complexity, introducing fresh challenges that keep your mind sharp. Whether you're sliding blocks to free up space or outsmarting tricky obstacles, every solved puzzle brings a surge of satisfaction—making each victory even more rewarding.

name: Frozen City
description:
A city-building simulation game set in an ice and snow apocalypse. As the chief of the last town on Earth, you have to gather resources and rebuild society.
Collect resources, assign workers, explore the wilderness, conquer tough surroundings, and use various methods in order to survive.

name: Ace Racer
description: Ace Racer is a racing mobile game introducing innovative vehicles with ultimate skills. Experience various actual cars from legendary vehicle manufacturers like Porsche and Nissan, along with our own custom creations. Each vehicle has its own ultimate skills. So, what are you waiting for? Start your engines and experience our own spin on vehicle ultimates along stunning race tracks! Let's race with ultimate skills to feel ultimate thrills.

name: Number Match - Numbers Game
description: Number Match is an addictive number puzzle game with simple rules and engaging gameplay. Match pairs of equal numbers or pairs that add up to 10 to clear the board. Train your logic and concentration skills, and try to beat your high score!

name: Farming Simulator 2011
description: You start the game by choosing from a small collection of vehicles and machinery to explore your fairly sparse farmland which measures just 4 km. As you progress through the game you complete a variety of tasks like breeding and feeding the cows or spreading manure, milking, plowing, seeding and baling to build up wealth to invest in newer and better equipment and machinery.

name: Offroad King: Car Drive Games
description: Get ready for a journey with Offroad King: Car Drive Game, the ultimate choice among 4x4 offroad games! Immerse yourself in the rugged beauty of untamed landscapes as you experience the thrill of Jeep Offroad of 4x4 car driving. choose your vehicle, and get ready to tackle offroad challenges trails for drive zone offroad and conquer obstacles in the most thrilling 4x4 offroad simulator. Compete with opponents in thrilling rally racing events.

name: Nonogram.com Color
description: Nonogram.com Color brings a fresh, colorful twist to classic nonogram puzzles with easy-to-follow rules and enhanced gameplay. Players follow number and color clues to fill the grid, switch between colors and mark empty cells to complete each puzzle and reveal hidden images. Nonogram.com Color offers relaxing yet challenging puzzles for beginners and experienced players.

name: My Memory Shop-Global
description:
Reborn a Tycoon, Living the high life!
Step into My Memory Shop, build your business empire from scratch.

name: Nonogram.com
description: Nonogram.com is an addictive logic game featuring a vast collection of picture cross puzzles. Players solve the puzzles across multiple difficulty levels and categories, using number clues to color the correct squares and reveal hidden images. The game offers a relaxing yet mentally engaging way to unwind and sharpen the mind for both beginners and experienced players.

name: Primitive Era: 10000 BC
description:
We are not only searching for the origin of humans, but also the starting point of mother earth.
Join the new casual SLG Primitive Era: 10000 BC to explore the magnificence of prehistoric civilizations such as Gendaya, Mesopotamia, Mulia, Atlantis and many others. Download the game and write your own history!

name: Logic Puzzles - Clue Game
description: Logic Puzzles is a classic logic grid puzzle game that challenges players to solve smart riddles using deduction and reasoning. Match clues in the grid to uncover correct solutions and progress through engaging story-based puzzles, offering an immersive way to train logical thinking and problem-solving skills.

name: Killer Sudoku by Sudoku.com
description: Killer Sudoku offers an exciting twist on classic sudoku, with challenging number puzzles perfect for brain training. While it’s more complex than traditional sudoku, multiple difficulty levels make it accessible for both beginners and experienced players. Users have to fill the grid using standard sudoku rules while ensuring each cage adds up to its target sum, with no repeated numbers in rows, columns, blocks, or cages.

name: Jigsaw Puzzles - Puzzle Game
description: Jigsaw Puzzles is a classic puzzle game with over 13,000 free beautiful HD pictures. Played by millions of puzzle lovers worldwide, it helps you exercise your short-term memory and concentration. No points, no gimmicks, and no missing pieces, just enjoy hours of fun putting puzzles together to calm down and relax.

name: Hidden Spots - Object Game
description: Hidden Spots is a relaxing puzzle game that offers a fresh twist on classic hidden object mechanics. Place objects into their correct hidden spots to complete charming scenes that come to life with playful animations, providing an engaging way to unwind while sharpening attention and observation skills.

name: Groovepad - Music & Beat Maker
description: Become a DJ with Groovepad! Groovepad is an easy-to-use beat maker that lets you create music, mix loops, and make smooth, groovy tracks in just a few taps. Choose your style, tap the pads, and bring your musical ideas to life anywhere.

name: Play eSailing
description:
Play eSailing is your F2P (free to play) sailing arcade game, where you in known boat classes, on classic race courses and realistic 3D venues are racing against friends, gamers and sailors worldwide.
An advanced wind engine will challenge your sailing tactical skills, while other players will try to prevent you from winning the race. Do you have the right knowledge of sailing rules and do you have the right strategic mindset? Test your skills in Play eSailing.

description: TwinSeek adalah game teka-teki premium cari perbedaan buatan NICMIT. Visual 100% buatan tangan tanpa konten AI. Mekanisme utama mencakup pengamatan detail melalui fitur zoom cerdas dan petunjuk Spotlight. Terdapat sistem 30 achievements serta leaderboard global untuk melacak skor kompetitif. Mendukung sinkronisasi Cloud (Apple/Google) dan fungsionalitas offline. Tanpa iklan paksa atau sistem energi. Game fokus pada ketelitian visual dan konsentrasi dalam pengalaman bermain yang tenang.

name: Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery
description: Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery is a fantasy role-playing game where players create their own character to experience life as a student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Players attend classes, learn spells and potions, investigate ancient mysteries, and forge alliances or rivalries with other students in an all-new story set in the Wizarding World.

name: MLB The Show Companion App
description: The MLB The Show Companion App provides a complementary experience for MLB The Show.

name: Cats are Liquid - A Better Place
description: Cats are Liquid - A Better Place is a 2D platformer about a liquid cat and her friends.

name: Dungeon Ward
description: Dungeon Ward is an action RPG based on old classic grid-based dungeon crawlers. It features 3d graphics, is about fighting monster and boss enemies, collecting loot and upgrading your character skills.

name: Cats are Liquid - A Light in the Shadows
description: Cats are Liquid - A Light in the Shadows is a minimalist 2D platformer about a liquid cat, locked in a world she doesn't quite understand, trying to get out.

name: Mythical Games
description: Jump into action-packed, arcade-style soccer gameplay with casual-friendly controls that make passing, shooting, and scoring effortless. Build a dream team of superstars, master football formations, refine offensive and defensive strategies, and make quick transfers with tactical depth and intuitive gameplay. Play the official FIFA experience anytime, anywhere!

name: Pudgy Party
description: Run, stumble, and fall through frozen battlegrounds packed with chaotic obstacles, survival knockout rounds, and high-stakes races. Play as your favorite Penguin characters, team up with friends, and dash past rivals in outrageous costumes to claim victory. With up to 20 players per match, it’s the ultimate penguin party royale from start to finish.

name: Antistress trivia - Zen Quiz
description: Zen Quiz is a relaxing trivia game with unlimited questions and zero pressure. No levels, no competitions, and no time limits — just calm, enjoyable learning at your own pace. Answer general knowledge questions on geography, science, history, food, animals, and more, and read detailed explanations after each one. Zen Quiz features an anti-stress design to help you unwind, improve focus, and boost your mood anytime.

name: Spades
description: Spades is a trick-taking game, a descendant of the Whist family of card games, where Spades is always trump.

name: American Canasta
description: American Canasta is a rummy-type card game. The goal of this card game is to form groups of 3 or more cards of the same value. A combination of seven or more cards is called a Canasta. Draw cards from the deck or the discard pile and meld all your cards as soon as possible to finish the game before the others, and achieve the highest score.

name: Nonogram Logic Pic
description:
olve endless logic puzzles and get a bit smarter every day while having fun!
You'll find that every picross puzzle is a new enigma waiting to be solved. With our app, your mind will be sharp and you'll have an endless supply of enigmas to keep you entertained and challenged.

name: Pro Solo Tree
description: Reaction timing game.

name: QuizzLand. Trivia Brain Test
description: QuizzLand is a fun and educational trivia game with unlimited unique questions across geography, history, science, art, nature, food, and more. Play at your own pace, improve memory and logic, and enjoy helpful explanations after each answer. Explore a trivia maze of 21 questions per level, use hints, complete daily tasks, and try mini-games for brain training. Compete in duels, battles, and leaderboards, or invite friends for extra rewards.

name: We Are Illuminati
description:
What do pop idols, freemasonry enthusiasts, world leaders and scaly-skinned aliens have in common besides money, power and cleverly disguised spaceships?
They are all part of the multiverse!
Join their ranks and influence as many people as you can through any means necessary! Mind control, Iluminati fake news, hidden messages in music videos, weird chemicals on water supplies: there’s a surprisingly wide array of paths for world domination in this multiverse simulator clicker.

name: Burako
description: Burako is a very popular rummy-type game.

name: Backyard Baseball 97
description: Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997, now updated for modern systems! Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids, aim for those home runs, and various game modes. Relive the magic of this classic baseball game!

name: Mighty Party
description:
Dive into the Magical World of Mighty Party!
Unleash the full potential of your strategic prowess in Mighty Party, a thrilling blend of turn-based strategy, role-playing, and battle RPG elements. Embark on an MMORPG adventure like no other, challenging gamers globally in electrifying battle arenas.

name: Canasta Hand and Foot
description: Hand and Foot is a card game, a variant of the classic game Canasta.

name: Fishy
description: Welcome to the world of Fishy! It's getting pretty crowded down here, and if you want to last in this underwater arena, you'll need to outsmart and outmaneuver the larger predators, all the while building your strength by eating any smaller prey you can find.

name: AdventureQuest 3D
description: A fantasy, cross-platform, massively multiplayer game that allows you to create and play your character, on Steam (PC & Mac), Android, and Apple iOS devices. AdventureQuest 3D is updated weekly with new content and things to do.

name: Kitty Keep
description: Grow a cat army of adorable fluff to defend your beach castle against enemies!

name: Defend Your Castle
description: Prepare to Defend your Castle against the relentless army of crayon invaders! Those crafty barbarian hordes have amassed their forces once again to challenge your domain. Will you an your court rise to the challenge, or stand aside as they raze your Castle to the ground?

name: Skullgirls: Fighting RPG
description: Skullgirls is a 2D Fighting RPG packed with unique, colorful characters to collect, upgrade, and customize as you search for the mysterious SKULLGIRL! Custom controls designed specifically for mobile allow you to effortlessly execute a wide variety of amazing moves and combos with a single tap or swipe. Discover deep tactical choices mixed with gameplay that’s easy to pickup and play.

name: Planetenspielundapp2b
description: Celestial Body Company and learning Game

name: Potion Punch 2
description: Potion Punch 2 takes the cooking fever to an all time high with baby dragons roasting ingredients, and magic wisps freezing your favorite treats or grilling your delicious steaks! Cook in ways that you've never seen before in a fast paced time-management game. Become the star chef through hundreds of levels teeming with amazing heroes and dastardly villains. Unfurl your scrolls, polish your frying pans, and open the restaurant doors, because it's time for cooking madness in Potion Punch 2!

name: Peridot
description: Players raise creatures called "Peridots" or "Dots" from infancy to adulthood. Each Dot is genetically unique, featuring varied traits and archetypes that can resemble real animals. Adult Dots can be bred with others to create new generations of genetically diverse offspring.

name: Wild Castle
description: Defend your castle and grow your empire!

name: Silverfish DX
description: Arcade game where you avoid bugs until you powerup enough to eat them, like a free-form Pac-Man.

name: SHREDD
description: Simple two-finger dodging game.

name: MLB® The Show™ Mobile Baseball
description: The Authentic MLB Experience

name: Bowling Crew — 3D bowling game
description: Switch between fascinating bowling balls to knock down all ten pins and get a strike! Win epic PvP-battles to gain rewards. Level up to win even more bowling matches and climb to the top of this free, fun multiplayer game.

name: Flags quiz & national anthem
description: Learn the national anthems and play quizzes to find the correct country by its flag or name.

name: Crazy Rush 3D: Race Master
description:
Crazy Rush 3D is the modern racing game will delight you with realistic behavior of cars on the city track and a system of damage.
Get ready for the high-octane car stunt action! Drive and smash to win the chase and become the race master!

name: Amazeballs
description: Pleasing simulation to drop balls of different sizes on the screen and use device's accelerometer to direct them around the display.

name: Hair Tattoo: Barber Shop Game
description:
Clients will come to the hair salon with the desire to make a new hairstyle or shave! Your task is to cut, shave, color and style your hair with the highest quality, so that the client leaves the hair salon satisfied! If you mess up your hair, the client will leave in anger, and you won't get paid!
Your hair salon will have all the necessary cutting tools you need to master!
With their help, you'll be able to create hair cut tattoos, change hair color, and shave!

name: Demise of Nations
description: Demise of Nations is a 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame covering the rise of Rome till the fall of modern civilization.

name: Age of Conquest IV
description: Age of Conquest is a Risk-like turn-based grand strategy wargame.

name: State Connect: Traffic Control
description: This connection game is very easy to control and incredibly enjoyable to play. A huge number of different options for the road construction of transit systems. To build a highway - just slide your finger from one point to another and the movement will begin! Don't forget to upgrade your cities to create even more freeways and take over the world! State Connect will make you feel like a real road manager and transport planner who can conquer world domination!

name: Animal Herd
description: Animal herding game

name: Knight's Edge: PvP Raid Arena
description: Pick your weapon and dive into Knight’s Edge! Team up in intense 3v3 matches, battle monsters, and outsmart rival teams. Do you have what it takes to rise to the top?

name: Delicious - Hopes and Fears
description: A casual time-management cooking game where you serve food fast, manage customers, and complete challenging levels.

name: Kokoro Kids
description: Kokoro Kids is an educational games app for children aged 2–7 that supports early cognitive and socioemotional development through play. It offers hundreds of adaptive mini-games across skills like literacy, numeracy, attention, and emotional regulation, designed to personalize learning for each child.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 Classic
description: A classic platformer. Race at lightning speeds across seven classic zones as Sonic the Hedgehog, Tails or Knuckles.  Run and spin through loop-de-loops as you collect rings and defeat enemies on your mission to save the world from the evil Dr. Eggman.

name: Winged
description:
Winged is an auto-runner platformer that unlocks books! And books are part of the gameplay, as it's through them that the avatar gains new "wings," a metaphor for the concept of "wings of imagination" that books teach us.
Embark on an enchanting journey, where each collected page opens doors to new literary adventures.

name: Oyaji
description: A delightfully simple find-it game. Your eccentric boss fell asleep and now you’re trapped in his dreams. Can you find everything and navigate your way through his wild memories?

name: Dark Legends
description: Horror massively multiplayer online game

name: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 ™ Classic
description: A classic platformer. Race at lightning speeds across seven classic zones as Sonic the Hedgehog, Tails or Knuckles.  Run and spin through loop-de-loops as you collect rings and defeat enemies on your mission to save the world from the evil Dr. Eggman.

name: Jimmy's Cartel Poker
description: Jimmy's Cartel Poker brings you a Gangster themed Texas Hold'Em Social Poker experience with hundreds of tables across 3 Casinos. The games are intended for an adult audience. The games do not offer "real money gambling" or an opportunity to win real money or prizes.

name: Star Legends
description: Science fiction hack and slash online multiplayer game

name: Smashing Four: PvP Hero bump
description: Feel the rush as you dive deeper into the heart of battle with every move you make! In this adrenaline-pumping expansion of the arena, the thrill of the rush is undeniable as you navigate through the electrifying world of Smashing Four. With every match, the intensity increases, pushing you to make strategic decisions on the fly. Harness the rush of excitement as you deploy your heroes, each with their unique abilities, in a chess-like battle of wits and strength.

name: Math Rocket
description:
Disarm Rockets with Fast Math Skills!

Math Rocket is a thrilling way to sharpen your mental math speed. Solve equations fast to stop incoming rockets before they hit your castle! It’s a brain-boosting math game that combines action, speed, and problem-solving in one exciting challenge.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog Classic
description: A classic platformer. Race at lightning speeds across seven classic zones as Sonic the Hedgehog.  Run and spin through loop-de-loops as you collect rings and defeat enemies on your mission to save the world from the evil Dr. Eggman.

name: Pocket Legends
description: With over 100 levels of multiplayer co-op and PVP action, Pocket Legends dominates the world of mobile MMORPGs! Join players from around the world for crazy adventures in creepy dungeons, frigid mountain peaks, and steamy swamps. Play with friends make new friends as you master each of 5 legendary character classes.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog™ Classic
description: A classic platformer. Race at lightning speeds across seven classic zones as Sonic the Hedgehog.  Run and spin through loop-de-loops as you collect rings and defeat enemies on your mission to save the world from the evil Dr. Eggman.

name: World War Heroes — WW2 5v5 FPS / World War Heroes: WW2 FPS PVP
description:
Battle players from around the world in a crazy WWII-era online first person shooter game!
Destroy the enemy and survive tank battles in the center of Berlin and other cities. Participate in team and deathmatch battles, plant bombs and defend them, take part in world war massive warfare!

name: Clockmaker: Match 3 Puzzles
description: This is a casual match-3 puzzle game with a story-driven adventure setting. Players complete match-3 levels, solve simple puzzles, and progress through a narrative about lifting a curse from a town. The game includes optional in-app purchases and advertisements.

name: Arcane Legends
description: Over 80 Levels of magical monster-stomping content! Custom 3D characters, cute and powerful pets, player-to-player trade, player-versus-player combat, Seasonal Leaderboards, and regular Events.

name: Never Alone
description: Experience the epic journey of Nuna and Fox as they search for the source of an eternal blizzard that threatens the survival of everything they have ever known.

name: Animation Throwdown
description: Family Guy, Bob's Burgers, Futurama, American Dad, King of the Hill, and Archer join forces in Animation Throwdown, your favorite new collectible card game. Collect your favorite characters, combine cards to make hilarious combos, and battle your way through an adventure of animated proportions.

name: Intellecto Kids Learning Games
description: Educational learning games for preschool children that help develop basic skills such as letters, numbers, logic, and memory in a safe, child-friendly environment.

name: Sonic Dash 2: Sonic Boom
description:
"n and above the beautiful Sonic Boom world
- MASTER new Swing & Tilt gameplay with the super charged Enerbeam; tilt your device to swing the runner towards the rings and orbs
- COLLECT, evolve, and run with new magical Sprites
- EARN special prizes in new Events and Daily SEGA Challenges
- LEVEL UP by earning XP to max out your score and UNLOCK NEW CHALLENGES
- LEADERBOARDS let you compete against the world"

name: Family Island™ — Farming game
description: Family Island is a mobile farming and adventure game set in a whimsical Stone Age world, where a modern family—Bruce, Eva, and their two children—must rebuild their lives after a volcanic eruption destroys their city and leaves them stranded on a remote island.

name: Avakin Life
description: AVAKIN LIFE virtual world: An immersive 3D experience where you can meet people, chat, and dress up! Decorate and design your home and visit stunning, paradise-like locations! A simulation and role-playing game with tons of possibilities!

name: Hair Salon 4
description: Welcome to Toca Boca Hair Salon 4! Unleash your creativity in the salon and whip up any style you can imagine. Whether you choose a character and create a brand-new look you’ve dreamed up or just see where the tools take you, each makeover is an adventure. Get creative with makeup, face paint, hair and beard tools, and much more!

name: Beyond Blue
description: Beyond Blue is a single-player narrative adventure that takes you deep into our planet’s beating blue heart. Explore the awesome wonder and unbounded mystery that exists within the world’s ocean.

name: Kingdom Clash - Strategy Game / Kingdom Clash: Medieval Defense
description: Embark on a journey to a medieval realm mired in cruel wars between kingdoms! Defend your lands and become a real champion of the realm in this great ancient battle simulator strategy game!

name: Minion Rush
description:
"Experience the ultimate endless running adventure in Minion Rush! With updated new features, exciting challenges, and nonstop fun from Illumination’s Minions franchise, this refreshed  game is bigger, bolder, and better than ever!
Join more than a billion players and experience endless mischief, mayhem, and fun in Minion Rush! Download now and start your adventure!"

name: Happy Hill
description: HappyHill is a casual, relaxing puzzle game. Your goal in the game is to recreate the pattern of each puzzle in as few moves as possible or before the time runs out.

name: Sago Mini Trips+
description:
HIT THE ROAD WITH YOUR SAGO MINI FRIENDS! 
Ready for adventure? Sago Mini Trips+ brings together four fan-favorite preschool games into one kid-friendly app – Road Trip, Boats, Planes, and Trains. Travel to far-off destinations with your Sago Mini friends and discover lots of fun and surprises along the way! With no WiFi or internet required, it’s perfect for on-the-go playtime or your next big trip.

name: Happy Color
description: Happy Color is a “color-by-number” mobile application. Users fill pre-segmented, static illustrations by matching a numbered color palette to corresponding numerical indices on the image grid. The content of the application consists of a developer-curated library of diverse themes such as nature, animals, mandalas, and other categories.

name: Michi: World
description: Find a path based on set rules through a set of buildings and complete a circle. It's a slitherlink-like puzzle

name: Toca Boca Jr Classics
description:
9 FAN-FAVORITE GAMES IN 1 APP 
Get ready to play your way with a collection of Toca Boca Jr’s most-loved games! Perfect for ages 4-10, you’re free to play, create, and explore at your own pace. Build a world to explore in Blocks, take care of animals in Pet Doctor, or find your style in Hair Salon. There’s so much to do in Toca Boca Jr. Classics!

name: Cook Pizza: Kitchen Food Maker
description: Cooking game where you follow real chef-inspired recipes and prepare delicious Italian pizza step by step. Choose a recipe, knead the dough, slice ingredients, add cheese and toppings, and bake your perfect pizza in a warm, atmospheric virtual kitchen.

name: Tales of a Vagrant
description: An arcade action game game set in feudal japan.

name: Burger Max: Chef Cooking Game
description: 3D cooking simulator where you can prepare delicious burgers step by step using real chef recipes you can even try at home. No timers, no chaos—just pure relaxation and authentic cooking fun.

name: Sago Mini Jinja's Garden
description:
EXPLORE A MAGICAL NEW WORLD
Join your Sago Mini friends in a 3D open world adventure! Thoughtfully designed for kids aged 3-6, Jinja’s Garden is cozy, open-ended play full of fun and surprises. Plant gardens, harvest ingredients, help friendly neighbors, and explore at your own pace. Let’s get growing!

name: Scuba Adventures
description: Race the clock in Scuba Adventure VR as a marine biologist tagging creatures before your oxygen tank runs out of air. Navigating an underwater world in the Philippines, you will come face to face with a dumbo octopus, clownfish, shark, sea turtle, dolphin, lobster, and get dangerously close to venomous marine snails. Earn extra points for tagging venomous creatures whose deadly toxins may unlock the secrets to saving human lives.

name: Leon's Mahjong
description: Leon’s Mahjong is a retro pixel-art Mahjong solitaire inspired by classic 16-bit computers. Designed as a calm, focused experience, it features handcrafted boards, intuitive touch controls, and a minimalist aesthetic—no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases. Just Mahjong, the way it used to be.

name: Sago Mini FIrst Words
description:
THE BEST SPEECH COMPANION FOR KIDS
Sago Mini First Words is the most playful way to support your little one’s speech development! Discover thoughtfully-designed learning games developed with the guidance of speech-language pathologists, child psychologists, and child development experts. Little ones practice articulation, pronunciation, and boost communication skills in English.

name: GeoGuessr
description: GeoGuessr is a geography-based exploration game where players are placed in a random location using street-level imagery and must guess where they are on the world map. Players use visual clues such as signs, landmarks, language, and landscapes to pinpoint their location and earn points based on accuracy. The game focuses on learning and discovery and contains no violence, explicit content, or gambling. The player can see locations in the world where people can consume alcohol or cigarettes.

name: Mathtango
description:
MathTango makes learning addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division engaging and fun for kids aged 5-10+! 

They’ll progress through hundreds of playful math games for kids – collecting monsters, completing missions, building unique worlds, and discovering lots of fun and surprises along the way. Trusted by parents and teachers, MathTango helps kids learn math skills and build confidence – all while having fun!

name: Sago Mini School
description: Sago Mini School is the best learning app for kindergarten readiness! Discover 300+ school games for kids that develop academic and life skills through play. Easy for kids to navigate independently, Sago Mini School is evidence-backed screen time parents trust.

name: Gabby's Dollhouse
description:
Welcome to Gabby’s Dollhouse:

- Explore a home full of games, surprises and magic.

- Unbox cute, miniature and exciting surprises.

- Discover new hobbies and make friends with the most adorable kitties.

- Sing, paint, cook, plant, craft and have fun with Gabby at your side.

name: Tic Tac Toe • Morpion • OXO
description: Rediscover the joy of Tic Tac Toe, also known as Noughts and Crosses or OXO, with a sleek design and intuitive interface. Whether you're nostalgic for games played on paper or discovering this timeless game for the first time, our app offers a smooth and enjoyable experience.

name: Cook Off: Hamburger FF3 Game
description: An educational cooking simulation focused on learning real food preparation through interactive play.

name: Labyrinth City
description: Labyrinth City takes you on a trip through a fantastic world of underground cities, hot-air balloons, tree-tops and haunted houses. Find your way through each interactive maze, engage with colorful characters, explore hidden pathways, unlock pieces of clues and solve the mystery along the way.

name: Cosmic Royale
description: Welcome to Cosmic Royale, a thrilling online battle royale with a cosmic twist! Take on 24 players, avoid obstacles, and use strategy to claim the title of champion in this fast-paced karting experience.

name: PAW Patrol Academy
description: PAW Patrol to the Rescue! This PAWsome app features interactive learning games for toddler girls and boys, plus real episode clips! Designed for preschool and kindergarten kids aged 2-5, it’s a brand-new way to experience the hit Nickelodeon show PAW Patrol – and the best way to get your biggest (or smallest) PAW Patrol fan smiling, laughing, and learning.

name: Crayon Club
description:
ARTS & CRAFTS WITHOUT THE CLEAN-UP!
Spark creativity with the most playful coloring app for ages 2-6! Safe, ad-free, and easy to use, Crayon Club brings the magic of arts and crafts to your child’s fingertips. Choose from hundreds of coloring pages, including PAW Patrol, Gabby's Dollhouse, Vida the Vet, Mighty Express, holiday favorites, and more – with new content added every month!

name: Referee Simulator 2026
description: Referee Simulator 2026 is a football referee simulation game where players make match decisions such as fouls, cards, goals, and penalties. The game does not contain blood, gambling, or inappropriate content.

name: Games for Cats Cat Toy – Meow
description: MEOW app is created for CATS (and approved by CATS :) ), so you just sit back and have fun watching your kitty have the best time ever! Meow comes with the BEST collection of games for cats – let your cat chase fish, mice, butterflies, spiders, lizards, and more!

name: Daisys Revenge
description: - Listen to the music from The Dead Daisies while shooting the ravens!

name: Toca Boca Jr
description: Discover the best games for kids ages 2-8, trusted by over 100 million families! Toca Boca Jr is full of imaginative ways for kids to play, create, build worlds, and explore. Bringing together Toca Boca’s most-loved games in one app, kids boost problem-solving skills, explore self-expression, and spark interests through the power of play.

name: Hoby Tales
description:
Fairytale match-3 puzzle game with Hobs! Free game without internet. No ads!
“Hoby Tales” is a game for the whole family! Heartwarming fairy tales from childhood, colourful graphics and tricky levels will keep you entertained!
Solve clever puzzles by making matches and creating 3-in-a-row combinations.

name: Out There: Ω Edition
description: You are an astronaut awaking from cryonics not in the solar system, but... out there... in a far and unknown place of the galaxy. In Out There, you will have to survive, tinkering your ship with what you can gather drifting in the void, and spot garden planets to refill your oxygen supply.

name: Crowns Keeper
description: Crowns Keeper is a score keeping app for the game 5 Crowns. Users use real cards, and the resulting score is kept in Crowns Keeper. No financial transitions, gambling or lottery occur in app or with real players.

name: Meowtopia: Zodiac Merge
description: Casual merge game where you collect and evolve cats, collect rare zodiac creatures and decorate your island

name: Sonic Forces: Run Battle Game
description: Sonic Forces stands out among running games, offering the perfect fusion of endless runner and multiplayer fun race action. Select your iconic racer from the Sonic universe to run, race, and compete in multiplayer running games with real players from around the world for lightning fast competitive race games!

name: Beecarbonize
description:
Do you have what it takes to save the planet? Beecarbonize is an environmental card strategy game with climate change as your opponent.

Research cutting-edge technologies, enact policies, protect ecosystems, and modernize industry to cut down carbon emissions. Manage your resources well and you might survive.

name: Sniper Strike
description: Sniper Strike is a high-octane sniper experience that pits you in battle across three gameplay modes and hundreds of missions. Experience a AAA rated sniper game like never before on mobile.

name: Playing Prague
description: Create your own charming historical cityscape! Playing Prague is a relaxing bohemian puzzle game where Prague’s historic city center comes alive under your fingertips. Watch the city grow as you match patterns using symbols from the streets of Prague Old Town.

name: Train your Brain - Memory
description:
Stimulate your memory and have fun with memory senior games. A complete collection of games that will help you develop your memory skills while having fun. 
Within this app you will find different games to test your capacity of retention and memory in the short and long term.

name: Alice's Dream ： Merge Games
description: "Alice's Dream :Merge Games" is a casual puzzle game adapted from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and Through the Looking-Glass. Players follow Ellie, Alice's descendant, through a magical wonderland. With core "element merging + scene restoration" mechanics, they repair classic scenes, meet fairy tale characters, and explore a unique order system with magical recipes. It also offers updated fairy tales, holiday dungeons, and a skin system, with a relaxed vibe for players aged 13+.

name: Dark War Survival
description: Dark War Survival is a game that transitions from an atmospheric night escape experience into a deep SLG. Driven by a rich narrative in the early game, it seamlessly guides players into traditional late-game strategy content, such as building upgrades and territory conquest

name: Love & Pies - Merge Mystery
description:
Are you ready to solve the mystery of Appleton and unlock exciting family secrets? When someone burns down a family cafe, everyone’s a suspect! Follow the exciting Love & Pies story and keep your ears open for small-town gossip to help Amelia find answers - and maybe even fall crazy in love.

Decorate, manage and build your own cafe and garden into a thriving business! Merge cakes, cookies and other yummy ingredients to make tasty treats, serve customers and renovate your cafe.

name: Night in the Woods
description:
College dropout Mae Borowski returns home to the crumbling former mining town of Possum Springs seeking to resume her aimless former life and reconnect with the friends she left behind. But things aren't the same. Home seems different now and her friends have grown and changed. Leaves are falling and the wind is growing colder. Strange things are happening as the light fades.

And there's something in the woods.

Join Mae on a trip through her hometown and into the dark on the other side.

name: Rugby Nations 26
description: Rugby Nations 26 is a simulation of the sport of Rugby Union. You build your own team of players and play rugby games where you control one player at a time in passing, tackling, scrums, line-outs, try scoring and conversion kicks. You add to your team by opening player card packs that are either given out as rewards for playing or purchases in the store for real money.

name: Ragnarok X: Next Generation
description: As the official evolution of Ragnarok Online, ROX delivers new visuals, strategic combat, and diverse gameplay, staying true to its roots with fair loot and free trading.

name: Sonic Dash: Endless Runner
description: Sonic Dash: Endless Runner is an endless running game where you navigate 3D race courses, collect rings and race past challenging obstacles

name: Last Z: Survival Shooter
description: Last Z: Survival Shooter is a strategy game that incorporates multiplier gate mechanics. It transitions from casual minigame gameplay in the early stages to a traditional SLG experience in the late game, featuring building upgrades and territory conquest.

name: Wild West
description: Wild West: New Frontier is a farming and village life simulation where players build and manage their own ranch and town. Players can raise animals, harvest crops, produce goods in workshops, and expand their farm into a town with schools, hotels, and other buildings. The game includes train deliveries, fishing, and neighborhood competitions. An internet connection is required for updates, autosave, and online interaction with other players.

name: Acki Nacki - Popit Game
description:
Play Popit Game — a massively multiplayer roguelike card game. Сlimb a tower of Blocks. Use game-breaking Popits to defeat other players. Chain strategic combos to boost your score and sabotage your rivals on the live leaderboard.


Gameplay Overview
Calculate, maneuver, and outplay others using your deck. Pair it with tactically deployed Popits. And don't forget to count.

name: Rando'knights
description: An offline game about figurine collection and modification

name: Bombaroom AR
description: Bombaroom turns your world into a playful battlefield. Using Augmented Reality, it drops cannons and targets right onto your rug, sofa, or backyard—letting you blast cartoon cannonballs at pirate ships, castles, and more.

name: Kahoot! Learn Chess: DragonBox

Dive Into The Nullverse, Master Your Rogueteers to make the last stand against unfolding shadow algorithms. Choose your Rogueteer, unite in the virtual realm, and participate in the rebellion to free enslaved digital worlds.

name: Thousands Layered Edge
description:
Thousands Layered Edge adalah game aksi/pertempuran yang disajikan dalam lingkungan 3D bergaya sumi-e yang indah. Game ini mengikuti perjalanan seorang samurai wanita yang bertujuan untuk mencegah perang saudara dengan mengalahkan empat Kensei, yang memimpin pemberontakan terhadap pasukan Kekaisaran. 
Pemain terlibat dalam pertarungan satu-lawan-satu, melakukan serangan dan parry menggunakan kontrol sentuh, dan dapat membuka keterampilan serta gerakan khusus saat mereka melanjutkan permainan.

name: Lokapala
description: Lokapala: Saga of the Six Realms adalah game Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) 5v5 yang berfokus pada skill dan strategi tim, dikembangkan oleh Anantarupa Studios, pengembang game asal Indonesia. Lokapala merupakan gim esports pertama dari Indonesia dan pertama di Asia Tenggara yang terinspirasi dari budaya regional.

name: Dadoo
description: DADOO: Twists, Turns, and Mischiefs is an online multiplayer snake and ladder game with superpowers and lots of mischief! Change the course of the game with various skill cards. Push your enemy to their demise. Really, don't be nice while playing this game.

name: Zombie District
description:
Zombie District adalah permainan Aksi Shooter dimana pemain mengendalikan sebuah karakter di kota mati, bertarung melalui level yang dipenuhi zombie sambil menggunakan berbagai senjata dan keterampilan untuk bertahan hidup. 
Permainan ini menampilkan skema kontrol yang unik, sistem cuaca yang realistis, dan berbagai senjata. 
Pemain dapat membuka kostum dan senjata yang lebih kuat seiring mereka maju dalam permainan.

name: Dislyte

name: Audition AyoDance
description: Audition AyoDance adalah game online dance rhythm dari MEGAXUS yang telah menjadi legenda sejak 2007. Pemain menari mengikuti irama beragam lagu, bersaing di berbagai mode seperti Beat Up, Battle Party, dan Couple Dance, sambil mengekspresikan diri lewat avatar dan fashion. Dengan komunitas yang kuat dan gameplay kompetitif, AyoDance tetap menjadi ruang sosial favorit para pemain hingga kini.

name: Warteg Gelora-Restaurant Sims
description: Warteg Gelora adalah game simulasi restoran sosial dari MEGAXUS. Pemain berperan sebagai pelayan di sebuah “warung”, menerima dan melayani pesanan pelanggan mulai dari ojek online, pekerja kantoran, hingga staf parkir. Pemain harus mengingat pesanan dengan baik, menghidangkan tepat waktu, dan mengikuti protokol kesehatan selama pandemi. Game ini menghadirkan suasana keseharian Indonesia, gameplay santai tapi menantang, dan papan skor untuk bersaing dengan pemain lain.

name: VILLAINS : Battle Royale
description: Villains : Battle Royale adalah game aksi strategi dari MEGAXUS di mana pemain mengendalikan robot unik dengan kemampuan berbeda untuk bertarung di arena. Kumpulkan dan tingkatkan robot, susun strategi formasi, serta hadapi musuh dalam mode PvE dan PvP. Dengan kombinasi aksi cepat dan taktik, game ini menawarkan pengalaman pertempuran robot yang seru dan kompetitif.

name: Granado Espada Mobile
description: Granado Espada Mobile adalah MMORPG dari MEGAXUS yang dapat dimainkan di mobile dan PC. Pemain dapat mengendalikan hingga tiga karakter sekaligus (MCC), membentuk tim dengan beragam peran untuk menjelajah dunia luas, menjalankan quest, dungeon, dan raid. Tersedia ratusan karakter, kostumisasi, fitur guild, serta mode PvE dan PvP yang menghadirkan pengalaman petualangan klasik dalam format modern.

name: AyoDance Mobile
description: AyoDance Mobile adalah game dance rhythm sosial dari MEGAXUS yang menghadirkan pengalaman menari mengikuti irama berbagai genre lagu populer. Pemain dapat bertanding di mode seperti Dance Battle, Team Battle, Club Dance, dan Couple Mode, serta mengekspresikan diri melalui avatar, fashion, dan dekorasi ruang. Selain kompetitif, game ini menjadi ruang sosial untuk berinteraksi, berkomunitas, dan bermain bersama teman secara online.

name: Kiko Survivor
description:
Kiko Survivor is a roguelite time survival RPG with simple gameplay, based on the hit Kids Animation TV series: KIKO.

Tingting's gaming device exploded! Trapping Kiko and Poli in virtual Asri Town. In order to escape, they must harness their new found abilities and battle through waves of enemies and bosses!

name: Kiko Run
description:
Dari sebuah seri animasi TV berkualitas tinggi yang menceritakan tentang seorang anak ikan bernama Kiko yang hidup di Underwater Valley, ‘Asri Town’.

Bergabunglah dalam petualangan seru bersama Kiko dan sahabat-sahabatnya, POLI, LOLA, PATINO, TINGTING, dan MAYO untuk menangkap KRABBOT.

Sebuah robot rusak yang dibuat oleh TINGTING untuk membantu penduduk Asri Town menyimpan koin, tetapi ternyata melarikan diri dan menghancurkan semuanya.

name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
description: Game memasak seru yang mengajak kamu menjalankan restoran bakso warisan nenek. Terima orderan pelanggan, upgrade dan kustomisasi tokomu, ikuti duel masak yang menegangkan, dan kembalikan kejayaan restoran warisan keluargamu!

name: The Blind Warrior
description: The Blind Warrior is an indie single-player action-adventure game with third-person gameplay. Play as Barda in 1860s West Java under Dutch colonial rule. Fight tyranny and uncover a conspiracy in this story-driven semi-open world inspired by the iconic Silat comic Si Buta dari Gua Hantu.

name: Point Blank
description:
Point Blank adalah permainan komputer daring yang dikembangkan oleh Zepetto untuk platform Windows. Point Blank pertama kali dirilis di Indonesia pada tahun 2009 dan saat ini dikelola oleh Zepetto Interactive Indonesia sejak 2019.
Point Blank merupakan gim tembak-menembak first-person yang cepat dan intens. Gim ini juga menghadirkan lingkungan yang destruktif dan dinamis, serta menawarkan opsi kustomisasi karakter dan keterampilan yang lebih mendalam.

name: Kidbash: Super Legend
description:
Kidbash: Super Legend is a roguelike action-platformer that blends nostalgic gameplay with a character-rich story.

You’ll play as Kidbash, a hero stricken with amnesia, rediscovering your true identity and purpose while navigating vibrant landscapes of the O.D.D., a world where forgotten video game characters reside, and conquering challenging levels.

name: Grim Trials
description:
Grim Trials is a heavy metal action roguelite game that combines crafting and character build customization. In this game, players take on the role of Avelin, a girl who has just been recruited as a Grim Reaper Trainee after her death.

Avelin will undergo a series of trials: defeating impure souls, completing tasks from reaper mentors, and cleansing her inner seven deadly sins. All these trials must be completed for Avelin to become a full-fledged Grim Reaper and return to the world to reunite with her beloved once more.

name: Blades of Mirage
description: Embark on an epic isometric action RPG set in a Southeast Asian-inspired world. As Mira, use your ability to create water-based weapons and explore ancient ruins scattered across unique islands. Confront corrupted, powerful creatures and solve intricate puzzles to secure the ancient relics.

name: Feed The Maw
description: In Feed the Maw, you and your crew will explore a perilous island, frantically loot for vital resources, appease the monstrous Maw with offerings before it consumes you, and work together to survive brutal monsters and natural disasters. Are you ready to dive into the fun, chaotic co-op challenge where only teamwork—and loot—guarantees survival?

name: 1998: The Toll Keeper Story
description: A narrative simulation game where you play as a mother-to-be working as a toll keeper in the fictional country of Janapa, a nation on the brink of chaos. Navigate daily challenges and make difficult moral choices to survive—all for the sake of your unborn child.

name: War Angels
description: War Angels puts you in charge of a hospital in the middle of a war. With scarce food, limited medicine, and waves of critically injured patients, every decision becomes a moral struggle. Who will you save when you can’t save them all?

description: A strategic tile-placement roguelike with Balatro-inspired power-up management. Join the flamboyant Uncle Luxman to build the ultimate traveling carnival, master attraction placement, unleash wild charm synergies, and satisfy dynamic crowd demands.

description: A first-person adventure set in an abandoned Indonesian hospital, where two content creators are in dire need of going viral. Explore alternatively as Sekar and Laras to discover and reveal all of the secrets you saw to the world.

description: In 1980, you land a teller job at Kertasia Bank thanks to your distant uncle. But the bank follows bizarre rules set by a foolish government. Face strict policies, tough customers, and moral choices while saving for your mom’s medical bills. Your fate is in your hands.

name: Montabi
description: A Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder where you build your deck by taming and assembling a team of Montabi. Engage in thrilling turn-based battles, strategically utilizing their unique abilities. Assemble a synergistic team and you just might save the city from evil!

name: Asbak
description: Asbak is a fast-paced hack-and-slash platformer where you chase down and slay demons born from humanity’s darkest fears.

name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
description: Zozo and The Lost Dreams is a 2D Metroidvania platformer inspired by classic Saturday-morning cartoons.

name: RAD: Repeat After Death
description: Repeat After Death is an action arcade platforming game where your actions become your own enemy. Make your way through the various dungeons and kill the monster with your attacks. Repeat this over and over again until you clear the dungeon. Simple enough, right? But beware, as your actions from every character before will haunt you and be repeated back in your next. Dodge your way through the many ghosts of your own movement to kill the guardian and get out of this looping purgatory.

name: Smith's Chronicles

name: TypeCaster
description: A once-shameless thief, cursed with a slow, agonizing death, must now embark on a perilous journey to the top of the legendary Tower of Trials. This 2.5D action RPG challenges you to master lightning-fast reflexes and precise typing to battle hordes of fearsome monsters guarding each floor. Harness powerful spells, uncover treasures, and push yourself to the limits in your battle against the unknowns. Will you rise to the challenge and break the curse, or will you become another victim?

name: Halu - The Fracture
description: An atmospheric, slow-burn psychological horror from a first-person view. Uncover a night that gradually fractures into blurred lines between reality and illusion — and face what should’ve stayed hidden.

name: DreadHaunt
description: Set on a forsaken island off Jakarta’s northern coast, a place steeped in arcane energy and unsolved mysteries, you will face anomalous entities, cursed objects, and strange phenomena that modern science cannot explain. Using specially designed tools infused with ancient amulets, you’ll confront these exotic creatures and spiritual threats.

name: Cursed Mansion
description: Cursed Mansion starts out in a deep forest. A mysterious storm drives Rose to seek shelter in a huge mansion which at first glance seems to be empty. As she enters, the door slams shut and traps her inside. She is forced to look for another way out only to discover something truly sinister has happened in the mansion... and it's still very much alive, lurking in the shadows of the Cursed Mansion.
